units.id: mission:Successors: Entering the Scar|Shortly after you enter this system, your ship's sensors begin to register small but progressive damage to the hull and internal systems, despite there being no other ships around. Equally confusing, your jump drive seems to still be partially active.|24|0
units.english: Shortly after you enter this system, your ship's sensors begin to register small but progressive damage to the hull and internal systems, despite there being no other ships around. Equally confusing, your jump drive seems to still be partially active.
units.italian: Poco dopo essere entrato in questo sistema, i sensori della nave cominciano a registrare danni piccoli ma progressivi allo scafo e ai sistemi interni, benché non ci sia nessun'altra nave nei paraggi. Altrettanto inspiegabile, il motore di salto sembra ancora parzialmente attivo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Safe at Last|The system on the other side of the wormhole is the first one in days that your sensors have not responded to with alarms. Apart from the presence of the wormhole, the space here appears entirely normal.|37|0
units.english: The system on the other side of the wormhole is the first one in days that your sensors have not responded to with alarms. Apart from the presence of the wormhole, the space here appears entirely normal.
units.italian: Il sistema dall'altra parte del cunicolo è il primo da giorni a cui i tuoi sensori non rispondono con allarmi. A parte la presenza del cunicolo, lo spazio qui sembra del tutto normale.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|name|42|0
units.english: First Contact with Octopods
units.italian: Primo contatto con gli ottopodi

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|description|43|0
units.english: The aliens in this area of space have indicated that you should travel to a system to the east.
units.italian: Gli alieni di questa zona di spazio ti hanno indicato di recarti in un sistema a est.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|After trudging through several shrouded and mostly-dead systems, you've finally found a planet with living inhabitants. As you enter the planet's upper atmosphere, your ship is surrounded by a trio of interceptors and thoroughly scanned. Soon after, the lead ship transmits a hail to you in a sharply flowing alien language before proceeding to a spaceport complex floating on a large structure along the coastline. The group corrals you onto one of the few fully-dry landing pads, and as the minutes wear on, a small crowd begins to form around your ship.|53|0
units.english: After trudging through several shrouded and mostly-dead systems, you've finally found a planet with living inhabitants. As you enter the planet's upper atmosphere, your ship is surrounded by a trio of interceptors and thoroughly scanned. Soon after, the lead ship transmits a hail to you in a sharply flowing alien language before proceeding to a spaceport complex floating on a large structure along the coastline. The group corrals you onto one of the few fully-dry landing pads, and as the minutes wear on, a small crowd begins to form around your ship.
units.italian: Dopo esserti fatto strada attraverso diversi sistemi avvolti dalla foschia e in gran parte morti, hai finalmente trovato un pianeta con abitanti vivi. Mentre entri nell'atmosfera superiore, la tua nave viene circondata da tre intercettori e scansionata a fondo. Poco dopo, la nave di testa ti trasmette un saluto in una lingua aliena dal flusso tagliente, poi punta verso un complesso spazioportuale che galleggia su una grande struttura lungo la costa. Il gruppo ti scorta su una delle poche piazzole del tutto asciutte, e col passare dei minuti intorno alla nave comincia a raccogliersi una piccola folla.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	You carefully open the <ship>'s hatch and step outside to make contact.|54|0
units.english: You carefully open the <ship>'s hatch and step outside to make contact.
units.italian: Apri con cautela il portello della <ship> ed esci per stabilire il contatto.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	The predominant species of aliens you see here are enormous octopods that rise up from the ground on their long, suckered arms. On average, they stand about three meters tall even with their arms coiled beneath them. Those standing on dry land are joined by others who slither out of a network of water-filled pools and channels to come and watch you. Their skin glistens with mucous wetness and you can see it changing color and texture as they run their hourglass-shaped pupils over your person and your ship.|55|0
units.english: The predominant species of aliens you see here are enormous octopods that rise up from the ground on their long, suckered arms. On average, they stand about three meters tall even with their arms coiled beneath them. Those standing on dry land are joined by others who slither out of a network of water-filled pools and channels to come and watch you. Their skin glistens with mucous wetness and you can see it changing color and texture as they run their hourglass-shaped pupils over your person and your ship.
units.italian: La specie dominante qui è fatta di ottopodi enormi che si sollevano da terra sui loro lunghi bracci muniti di ventose. In media sono alti tre metri anche con i bracci avvolti sotto di sé. A quelli che stanno sulla terraferma si uniscono altri che strisciano fuori da una rete di vasche e canali pieni d'acqua per venire a guardarti. La loro pelle luccica di umidità mucosa e la vedi cambiare colore e consistenza mentre passano le loro pupille a forma di clessidra sulla tua persona e sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	After a couple of minutes of activity within the crowd, one uniformed and especially vibrant individual breaks away from the rest and begins to move towards you, gliding gently and silently over the ground. They say something in the same strange language, shimmering with waves of color, and then wait expectantly for you to reply.|56|0
units.english: After a couple of minutes of activity within the crowd, one uniformed and especially vibrant individual breaks away from the rest and begins to move towards you, gliding gently and silently over the ground. They say something in the same strange language, shimmering with waves of color, and then wait expectantly for you to reply.
units.italian: Dopo un paio di minuti di movimento nella folla, un individuo in uniforme e particolarmente vivace si stacca dagli altri e comincia a venire verso di te, scivolando piano e silenzioso sul terreno. Dice qualcosa nella stessa lingua straniera, tremolando di onde di colore, poi aspetta che tu risponda.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	(Say nothing.)|58|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"Hello, I'm Captain <first> <last>."|60|0
units.english: "Hello, I'm Captain <first> <last>."
units.italian: "Salve, sono il capitano <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"I come in peace."|62|0
units.english: "I come in peace."
units.italian: "Vengo in pace."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	(Shoot them.)|64|0
units.english: (Shoot them.)
units.italian: (Spara loro.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	You draw your weapon and fire a shot directly at the center of the uniformed alien, but it does not manage to even scorch the fabric of their clothing. Before you have time to fire a second time, you hear an unfathomably loud noise that pushes you back and leaves you dead before your body even makes contact with the ground.|65|0
units.english: You draw your weapon and fire a shot directly at the center of the uniformed alien, but it does not manage to even scorch the fabric of their clothing. Before you have time to fire a second time, you hear an unfathomably loud noise that pushes you back and leaves you dead before your body even makes contact with the ground.
units.italian: Estrai l'arma e spari direttamente al centro dell'alieno in uniforme, ma il colpo non riesce nemmeno a bruciare il tessuto dei suoi vestiti. Prima che tu abbia il tempo di sparare una seconda volta, senti un rumore incomprensibilmente forte che ti spinge indietro e ti lascia morto prima ancora che il tuo corpo tocchi terra.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	The alien shuffles their arms in place and leans their face towards yours, repeating their earlier statement, this time more slowly and at a lower pitch. When you once again fail to give a satisfactory response, they pull away.|68|0
units.english: The alien shuffles their arms in place and leans their face towards yours, repeating their earlier statement, this time more slowly and at a lower pitch. When you once again fail to give a satisfactory response, they pull away.
units.italian: L'alieno fa scorrere i bracci sul posto e avvicina il viso al tuo, ripetendo quanto aveva detto, questa volta più lentamente e con un tono più basso. Quando di nuovo non dai una risposta soddisfacente, si ritrae.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	After a few more moments of silence, the alien grunts in a gesture reminiscent of a sigh of disappointment, then turns away and says something to another uniformed individual waiting on the edges of the now-substantial crowd. The other's skin flashes a bright blue before they leave, gliding towards one of the interceptors now parked alongside your ship.|70|0
units.english: After a few more moments of silence, the alien grunts in a gesture reminiscent of a sigh of disappointment, then turns away and says something to another uniformed individual waiting on the edges of the now-substantial crowd. The other's skin flashes a bright blue before they leave, gliding towards one of the interceptors now parked alongside your ship.
units.italian: Dopo altri momenti di silenzio, l'alieno grugnisce in un gesto che ricorda un sospiro di delusione, poi si volta e dice qualcosa a un altro individuo in uniforme che aspetta ai margini della folla ormai consistente. La pelle dell'altro lampeggia di blu intenso prima che se ne vada, scivolando verso uno degli intercettori ora parcheggiati accanto alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	They shortly return, holding in one of their arms a small spherical device, handing it to the alien who seems to be in charge. The leader in turn offers it to you, and burbles an unintelligible phrase in what you might have characterized as an encouraging tone. The individuals making up the crowd are by now stretching over each other to get a look at you, and you can see more of them in the distance gliding and swimming towards your landing site.|71|0
units.english: They shortly return, holding in one of their arms a small spherical device, handing it to the alien who seems to be in charge. The leader in turn offers it to you, and burbles an unintelligible phrase in what you might have characterized as an encouraging tone. The individuals making up the crowd are by now stretching over each other to get a look at you, and you can see more of them in the distance gliding and swimming towards your landing site.
units.italian: Tornano poco dopo, tenendo in un braccio un piccolo dispositivo sferico, e lo consegnano all'alieno che sembra al comando. Il capo a sua volta te lo offre, e borbotta una frase incomprensibile in quello che potresti definire un tono incoraggiante. Gli individui che compongono la folla ormai si allungano gli uni sopra gli altri per guardarti, e in lontananza ne vedi altri che scivolano e nuotano verso il tuo punto d'atterraggio.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	(Take the device.)|73|0
units.english: (Take the device.)
units.italian: (Prendi il dispositivo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	(Refuse.)|74|0
units.english: (Refuse.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|log|77|0
units.english: Made contact with a group of aliens to the far south of the Graveyard. Took a device from them which marked a system a couple of jumps the east.
units.italian: Hai preso contatto con un gruppo di alieni molto a sud del Graveyard. Hai accettato da loro un dispositivo che indicava un sistema a un paio di salti a est.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	You take the device from the alien. It liquefies the moment it touches your skin before freezing in mid-splash to project a small but detailed holographic star map of the surrounding systems. A star system a few jumps east of here is highlighted amidst a sea of alien lettering. The individual standing opposite you grunts energetically as the trio of interceptors begins to hover in preparation for takeoff: it would appear that these people, whoever they are, want you to travel there.|78|0
units.english: You take the device from the alien. It liquefies the moment it touches your skin before freezing in mid-splash to project a small but detailed holographic star map of the surrounding systems. A star system a few jumps east of here is highlighted amidst a sea of alien lettering. The individual standing opposite you grunts energetically as the trio of interceptors begins to hover in preparation for takeoff: it would appear that these people, whoever they are, want you to travel there.
units.italian: Prendi il dispositivo dall'alieno. Si liquefa nel momento in cui tocca la tua pelle, poi si congela a metà dello schizzo per proiettare una mappa stellare olografica piccola ma dettagliata dei sistemi circostanti. Tra un mare di caratteri alieni è evidenziato un sistema a pochi salti a est. L'individuo di fronte a te grugnisce con energia mentre i tre intercettori cominciano a librarsi per prepararsi al decollo: pare che questa gente, chiunque sia, voglia che tu vada fin là.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|log|82|0
units.english: Made contact with a group of aliens to the far south of the Graveyard. Refused to take a device from them and was forced to return to orbit.
units.italian: Hai preso contatto con un gruppo di alieni molto a sud del Graveyard. Hai rifiutato il dispositivo che ti offrivano e sei stato costretto a tornare in orbita.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	You back away from the alien offering you the strange device and into the safety of the <ship>'s hatch. Though none of the aliens make any move to harm you, you notice from inside that after a couple of minutes, water slowly begins to flow onto the landing pad. As your ship's landing gear begin to submerge, you are forced to take off while you still can.|83|0
units.english: You back away from the alien offering you the strange device and into the safety of the <ship>'s hatch. Though none of the aliens make any move to harm you, you notice from inside that after a couple of minutes, water slowly begins to flow onto the landing pad. As your ship's landing gear begin to submerge, you are forced to take off while you still can.
units.italian: Indietreggi dall'alieno che ti offre lo strano dispositivo e ti ritiri al riparo del portello della <ship>. Nessuno degli alieni fa nulla per farti del male, ma dall'interno noti che dopo un paio di minuti l'acqua comincia lentamente a fluire sulla piazzola. Quando il carrello d'atterraggio comincia a sommergersi, sei costretto a decollare finché puoi.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|dialog|94|0
units.english: At least one of the Successor interceptors escorting you has been destroyed. If you want to continue the Successors' story line, revert to an earlier save.
units.italian: Almeno uno degli intercettori dei Successori che ti scortano è stato distrutto. Se vuoi proseguire la linea narrativa dei Successori, torna a un salvataggio precedente.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|Without your Successor escorts, you are refused landing permission at <planet>'s spaceport and must return to orbit until they arrive.|98|0
units.english: Without your Successor escorts, you are refused landing permission at <planet>'s spaceport and must return to orbit until they arrive.
units.italian: Senza le tue scorte dei Successori, ti viene negato il permesso di atterraggio allo spazioporto di <planet> e devi tornare in orbita finché non arrivano.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|log|104|0
units.english: Made contact with a group of aliens to the far south of the Graveyard calling themselves "the Successors." Was instructed to return to Staja-Kella-Oa in eight days, when their government will decide what to do about my arrival.
units.italian: Hai preso contatto con un gruppo di alieni molto a sud del Graveyard che si fanno chiamare "i Successori". Ti è stato ordinato di tornare a Staja-Kella-Oa entro otto giorni, quando il loro governo deciderà cosa fare del tuo arrivo.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|log|105|0
units.english: The Successors are a society of aliens occupying a territory on the southeastern outer rim of the galaxy; amphibious octopods approximately three meters tall. They are governed by their High Houses, institutions built around several noble families whose scions wield political and military power. They have not encountered humans for 1500 years, at which time their Predecessors were exploring much of the galaxy.
units.italian: I Successori sono una società di alieni che occupa un territorio sul bordo esterno sudorientale della galassia: ottopodi anfibi alti circa tre metri. Sono governati dalle loro Casate Alte, istituzioni costruite intorno a diverse famiglie nobili i cui eredi detengono potere politico e militare. Non incontrano umani da 1500 anni, quando i loro Predecessori esploravano gran parte della galassia.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|Like last time, you are escorted by the interceptors to a landing pad on this planet's spaceport. Here, however, they guide you to a small, out-of-the way area at a great distance from the main complex, where several uniformed aliens are gathered on the landing pad, standing at attention.|111|0
units.english: Like last time, you are escorted by the interceptors to a landing pad on this planet's spaceport. Here, however, they guide you to a small, out-of-the way area at a great distance from the main complex, where several uniformed aliens are gathered on the landing pad, standing at attention.
units.italian: Come l'ultima volta, gli intercettori ti scortano fino a una piazzola dello spazioporto di questo pianeta. Qui però ti guidano verso una zona piccola e defilata, molto lontana dal complesso principale, dove diversi alieni in uniforme sono radunati sulla piazzola, sull'attenti.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	After waiting for several minutes, a shuttle lands on the pad beside yours and several individuals emerge from it. Two of them move in front of the rest, where they are allowed to pass by the guards and approach you. The one on the left is a uniformed officer wearing what appears to be heavy body armor with shimmering metallic plates that sparkle in the light. On the right is a smaller alien who is wrapped up in a dark, cocoon-like outfit from which their head and arms emerge. The officer says something to the smaller one, who quietly replies and then pulls from a pocket on their outfit a smooth sheet which they inspect several times before haltingly addressing you.|112|0
units.english: After waiting for several minutes, a shuttle lands on the pad beside yours and several individuals emerge from it. Two of them move in front of the rest, where they are allowed to pass by the guards and approach you. The one on the left is a uniformed officer wearing what appears to be heavy body armor with shimmering metallic plates that sparkle in the light. On the right is a smaller alien who is wrapped up in a dark, cocoon-like outfit from which their head and arms emerge. The officer says something to the smaller one, who quietly replies and then pulls from a pocket on their outfit a smooth sheet which they inspect several times before haltingly addressing you.
units.italian: Dopo aver atteso diversi minuti, una navetta atterra sulla piazzola accanto alla tua e ne scendono diversi individui. Due si portano davanti agli altri, dove le guardie li lasciano passare per avvicinarsi a te. Quello a sinistra è un ufficiale in uniforme che indossa quella che sembra una pesante armatura corporale, con placche metalliche scintillanti che brillano alla luce. A destra c'è un alieno più piccolo, avvolto in un abito scuro simile a un bozzolo da cui emergono la testa e le braccia. L'ufficiale dice qualcosa al più piccolo, che risponde piano e poi estrae da una tasca del proprio abito un foglio liscio che consulta più volte prima di rivolgerti la parola con esitazione.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"Hark... noble visitor! We bid thee... welcome and good tidings." The two eye you closely as they wait for a response.|113|0
units.english: "Hark... noble visitor! We bid thee... welcome and good tidings." The two eye you closely as they wait for a response.
units.italian: "Salve... nobile visitatore! Ti diamo... il benvenuto e lieti auspici." I due ti osservano attentamente mentre aspettano una risposta.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"Hello. I am Captain <first> <last>."|115|0
units.english: "Hello. I am Captain <first> <last>."
units.italian: "Salve. Sono il capitano <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"I'm <last> of the <ship>. Pleased to meet you."|116|0
units.english: "I'm <last> of the <ship>. Pleased to meet you."
units.italian: "Sono <last>, della <ship>. Piacere di conoscerti."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	The two once again proceed slowly and carefully, the speaker briefly conversing with the military officer before each phrase. "I am Sieasej... of House Sioeora among the Successors. Thou'rt a human, art thou not?"|117|0
units.english: The two once again proceed slowly and carefully, the speaker briefly conversing with the military officer before each phrase. "I am Sieasej... of House Sioeora among the Successors. Thou'rt a human, art thou not?"
units.italian: I due procedono di nuovo lentamente e con cautela, e chi parla si consulta brevemente con l'ufficiale militare prima di ogni frase. "Sono Sieasej... di Casa Sioeora, tra i Successori. Tu sei un umano, non è vero?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"Yes, I am."|119|0
units.english: "Yes, I am."
units.italian: "Sì, lo sono."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"What else would I be?"|120|0
units.english: "What else would I be?"
units.italian: "E che altro dovrei essere?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	This sparks a wave of color among the gathered members, most of all Sieasej, who spends several seconds in a vibrant shade of orange before returning to their resting hue. "Then i'tis confirmed. 'Tis a cause for much excitement, <last>, for thou'rt the first of humans that's been met by us in fifteen hundred years, since far before the time thy kind had even left the bounds of thine own planet's clouds. House Sioeora's honored t'be the one that gives thee greeting. So am I, Captain, for my part in it." The members of the group splay their free arms towards you and glisten with ripples of blue across their skin. You perform a short bow in return.|121|0
units.english: This sparks a wave of color among the gathered members, most of all Sieasej, who spends several seconds in a vibrant shade of orange before returning to their resting hue. "Then i'tis confirmed. 'Tis a cause for much excitement, <last>, for thou'rt the first of humans that's been met by us in fifteen hundred years, since far before the time thy kind had even left the bounds of thine own planet's clouds. House Sioeora's honored t'be the one that gives thee greeting. So am I, Captain, for my part in it." The members of the group splay their free arms towards you and glisten with ripples of blue across their skin. You perform a short bow in return.
units.italian: Questo scatena un'onda di colore tra i presenti, soprattutto in Sieasej, che resta per diversi secondi in una vivace tonalità d'arancione prima di tornare al suo colore di riposo. "Allora è confermato. È motivo di grande emozione, <last>, perché sei il primo umano che incontriamo in millecinquecento anni, da molto prima che la tua specie lasciasse i confini delle nuvole del suo pianeta. Casa Sioeora è onorata di essere quella che ti dà il benvenuto. E lo sono io, capitano, per la parte che mi tocca." I membri del gruppo aprono i bracci liberi verso di te e luccicano di increspature blu sulla pelle. Tu rispondi con un breve inchino.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"What should I do now?"|124|0
units.english: "What should I do now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dovrei fare adesso?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"How do you know my language?"|126|0
units.english: "How do you know my language?"
units.italian: "Come fai a conoscere la mia lingua?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"What do you mean that you were ripped from the galaxy?"|130|0
units.english: "What do you mean that you were ripped from the galaxy?"
units.italian: "Che vuoi dire con 'siete stati strappati alla galassia'?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"How could you have met humans fifteen hundred years ago?"|135|0
units.english: "How could you have met humans fifteen hundred years ago?"
units.italian: "Come avete potuto incontrare umani millecinquecento anni fa?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"Humans have certainly changed a lot in the last fifteen hundred years."|139|0
units.english: "Humans have certainly changed a lot in the last fifteen hundred years."
units.italian: "Gli umani sono certo cambiati molto negli ultimi millecinquecento anni."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"What is House Sioeora?"|144|0
units.english: "What is House Sioeora?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è Casa Sioeora?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"T'was a time in which our Predecessors' home domains reach'd farther to the north, and farther still the reach of their intention to explore. For life, it is a rare and precious thing, and doubly so that life which is possess'd of sapience and culture, that's noble in reason, infinite in faculty, as thine. So then, our Predecessors waited under cloak of dark to silently observe thee in thy glimmering development. And if 'twere not from the rest of the stars so untimely ripp'd, we surely would have had the pleasure t'watch thy kind advance to what's its present point."|149|0
units.english: "T'was a time in which our Predecessors' home domains reach'd farther to the north, and farther still the reach of their intention to explore. For life, it is a rare and precious thing, and doubly so that life which is possess'd of sapience and culture, that's noble in reason, infinite in faculty, as thine. So then, our Predecessors waited under cloak of dark to silently observe thee in thy glimmering development. And if 'twere not from the rest of the stars so untimely ripp'd, we surely would have had the pleasure t'watch thy kind advance to what's its present point."
units.italian: "Ci fu un tempo in cui i domini dei nostri Predecessori si spingevano più a nord, e più lontano ancora arrivava la loro intenzione di esplorare. Perché la vita è cosa rara e preziosa, e doppiamente lo è quella vita che possiede sapienza e cultura, nobile nella ragione e infinita nelle facoltà, come la tua. Così i nostri Predecessori attendevano sotto il manto del buio per osservarti in silenzio nel tuo sviluppo scintillante. E se non fossimo stati strappati così prematuramente al resto delle stelle, avremmo certo avuto il piacere di guardare la tua specie avanzare fino al punto in cui è ora."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	Sieasej pauses for a moment, wriggling under their cloak. "I am a scholar of some olden languages," they say, "and of the worlds our Predecessors met so long ago. I learned thy tongue, at least as 'twas gone fifteen hundred years ago."|155|0
units.english: Sieasej pauses for a moment, wriggling under their cloak. "I am a scholar of some olden languages," they say, "and of the worlds our Predecessors met so long ago. I learned thy tongue, at least as 'twas gone fifteen hundred years ago."
units.italian: Sieasej si ferma un momento, dimenandosi sotto il proprio mantello. "Sono uno studioso di alcune antiche lingue," dice, "e dei mondi che i nostri Predecessori incontrarono tanto tempo fa. Ho imparato la tua lingua, o almeno quella che era millecinquecento anni fa."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|label|157|0

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"T'is true," they say. "I am a scholar of some olden languages, and of the worlds our Predecessors met so long ago. I learned thy tongue, at least as 'twas gone fifteen hundred years ago."|160|0
units.english: "T'is true," they say. "I am a scholar of some olden languages, and of the worlds our Predecessors met so long ago. I learned thy tongue, at least as 'twas gone fifteen hundred years ago."
units.italian: "È vero," dicono. "Sono uno studioso di alcune antiche lingue, e dei mondi che i nostri Predecessori incontrarono tanto tempo fa. Ho imparato la tua lingua, o almeno quella che era millecinquecento anni fa."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	More waves of color, subtle but noticeable, pass over Sieasej's body. "I'd hoped as much," they say, "that thou were't still a younger kind, with a longer history before thee; that thou would'st one day take to the stars as it appears thou hast now done. Alas, mine noble House Sioeora does not permit me t'interrogate thy knowledge so deep as that which I desire, for thine arrival portends t'us much, and so t'is much we must arrange."|165|0
units.english: More waves of color, subtle but noticeable, pass over Sieasej's body. "I'd hoped as much," they say, "that thou were't still a younger kind, with a longer history before thee; that thou would'st one day take to the stars as it appears thou hast now done. Alas, mine noble House Sioeora does not permit me t'interrogate thy knowledge so deep as that which I desire, for thine arrival portends t'us much, and so t'is much we must arrange."
units.italian: Altre onde di colore, sottili ma percettibili, passano sul corpo di Sieasej. "Lo speravo," dicono, "che foste ancora una specie giovane, con una storia più lunga davanti; che un giorno avreste preso le stelle, come pare abbiate fatto ora. Purtroppo la mia nobile Casa Sioeora non mi permette di interrogare la tua conoscenza tanto a fondo quanto desidererei, perché il tuo arrivo ci annuncia molto, e molto dobbiamo predisporre."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	Sieasej confirms their answer with the uniformed officer before answering your question. "Thou surely must have passed through that awry and fractured swathe of stars to which our modern worlds remain affixed, by however thin and fragile of a thread. 'Tis the citizens of these, long past, whose Successors now we are."|170|0
units.english: Sieasej confirms their answer with the uniformed officer before answering your question. "Thou surely must have passed through that awry and fractured swathe of stars to which our modern worlds remain affixed, by however thin and fragile of a thread. 'Tis the citizens of these, long past, whose Successors now we are."
units.italian: Sieasej conferma la risposta con l'ufficiale in uniforme prima di rispondere alla tua domanda. "Devi certo aver attraversato quella fascia di stelle distorta e fratturata a cui i nostri mondi moderni restano ancorati, per quanto sottile e fragile sia il filo. Sono i cittadini di quei mondi, molto tempo fa, di cui oggi siamo i Successori."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"T'was a time in which our Predecessors' home domains reach'd farther to the north, and farther still the reach of their intention to explore. For life, it is a rare and precious thing, and doubly so that life which is possess'd of sapience and culture, that's noble in reason, infinite in faculty, as thine. So then, our Predecessors waited under cloak of dark to silently observe thee in thy glimmering development. And if 'twere not from the rest of the stars so untimely ripp'd, we surely would have had the pleasure t'watch thy kind advance to what's its present point."|175|0
units.english: "T'was a time in which our Predecessors' home domains reach'd farther to the north, and farther still the reach of their intention to explore. For life, it is a rare and precious thing, and doubly so that life which is possess'd of sapience and culture, that's noble in reason, infinite in faculty, as thine. So then, our Predecessors waited under cloak of dark to silently observe thee in thy glimmering development. And if 'twere not from the rest of the stars so untimely ripp'd, we surely would have had the pleasure t'watch thy kind advance to what's its present point."
units.italian: "Ci fu un tempo in cui i domini dei nostri Predecessori si spingevano più a nord, e più lontano ancora arrivava la loro intenzione di esplorare. Perché la vita è cosa rara e preziosa, e doppiamente lo è quella vita che possiede sapienza e cultura, nobile nella ragione e infinita nelle facoltà, come la tua. Così i nostri Predecessori attendevano sotto il manto del buio per osservarti in silenzio nel tuo sviluppo scintillante. E se non fossimo stati strappati così prematuramente al resto delle stelle, avremmo certo avuto il piacere di guardare la tua specie avanzare fino al punto in cui è ora."

units.italian: "Che cosa dovrei fare adesso?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	"What is House Sioeora?"|185|0
units.english: "What is House Sioeora?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è Casa Sioeora?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	Sieasej translates your query to the military officer this time, who considers for a moment before saying something back and Sieasej speaks again. "Sioeora is the noble house whose grand estate thou sees around thee. There are many such within the broader realm: the stars this side'f the wormhole, but 'tis Sioeora who has taken patronage on thee, for the keeping of our history is the... core of its desire. 'Twere't thou apprehended by the arms of another," Sieasej says, gesturing towards an interceptor landed on another pad, "thou surely would have languished without recognition as a creature t'was so distant in our past."|192|0
units.english: Sieasej translates your query to the military officer this time, who considers for a moment before saying something back and Sieasej speaks again. "Sioeora is the noble house whose grand estate thou sees around thee. There are many such within the broader realm: the stars this side'f the wormhole, but 'tis Sioeora who has taken patronage on thee, for the keeping of our history is the... core of its desire. 'Twere't thou apprehended by the arms of another," Sieasej says, gesturing towards an interceptor landed on another pad, "thou surely would have languished without recognition as a creature t'was so distant in our past."
units.italian: Questa volta Sieasej traduce la tua domanda all'ufficiale militare, che riflette un momento prima di rispondere qualcosa, e poi Sieasej parla di nuovo. "Sioeora è la casata nobile della cui grande tenuta vedi ciò che ti circonda. Ce ne sono molte altre nel più ampio reame: le stelle da questo lato del cunicolo. Ma è Sioeora ad aver preso patrocinio su di te, perché la custodia della nostra storia è il... cuore del suo desiderio. Se fossi stato preso tra le braccia di un'altra," dice Sieasej, indicando un intercettore atterrato su un'altra piazzola, "saresti certo rimasto senza riconoscimento, come una creatura troppo lontana nel nostro passato."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	Sieasej translates this question to the uniformed officer, who conveys a detailed response accompanied by a series of color and texture displays on their skin. Overhead, a buzzing flock of interceptors fly past and land on a set of landing pads closer to the center of the spaceport complex. Eventually, Sieasej responds, and does so even more slowly and carefully than previously. "The noble scions o'House Sioeora have made it known t'others of the High Houses that thou'rt guest within their space and shalt proceed with their protection. Thou may'st explore those of our worlds which offer thee their grace. 'Thout our tongue, though, thou shalt find but few chances to do more than to observe. As to that," Sieasej continues, "our noble scions're set to start their meeting here in eight days time. And as it is that thou hast aroused their close attentions, 'tis expected that thou shalt receive a summons to their union."|201|0
units.english: Sieasej translates this question to the uniformed officer, who conveys a detailed response accompanied by a series of color and texture displays on their skin. Overhead, a buzzing flock of interceptors fly past and land on a set of landing pads closer to the center of the spaceport complex. Eventually, Sieasej responds, and does so even more slowly and carefully than previously. "The noble scions o'House Sioeora have made it known t'others of the High Houses that thou'rt guest within their space and shalt proceed with their protection. Thou may'st explore those of our worlds which offer thee their grace. 'Thout our tongue, though, thou shalt find but few chances to do more than to observe. As to that," Sieasej continues, "our noble scions're set to start their meeting here in eight days time. And as it is that thou hast aroused their close attentions, 'tis expected that thou shalt receive a summons to their union."
units.italian: Sieasej traduce questa domanda all'ufficiale in uniforme, che trasmette una risposta dettagliata accompagnata da una serie di esibizioni di colore e consistenza sulla pelle. Sopra di voi, uno stormo ronzante di intercettori passa e atterra su una serie di piazzole più vicine al centro del complesso spazioportuale. Alla fine Sieasej risponde, e lo fa con ancora più lentezza e cautela di prima. "Gli eredi della nobile Casa Sioeora hanno fatto sapere alle altre Casate Alte che sei ospite nel loro spazio e che procederai sotto la loro protezione. Potrai esplorare quei nostri mondi che ti offrono la loro grazia. Senza la nostra lingua, però, avrai ben poche occasioni di fare altro che osservare. Quanto a questo," continua Sieasej, "i nostri nobili eredi cominceranno la loro riunione qui tra otto giorni. E poiché hai destato la loro attenta curiosità, si attende che tu riceva un invito alla loro unione."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 1|	With that, Sieasej and some of the others depart, leaving you along on the pad with your ship and the ring of guards, who remain silent and at attention.|202|0
units.english: With that, Sieasej and some of the others depart, leaving you along on the pad with your ship and the ring of guards, who remain silent and at attention.
units.italian: Detto questo, Sieasej e alcuni degli altri si allontanano, lasciandoti solo sulla piazzola con la tua nave e l'anello delle guardie, che restano in silenzio e sull'attenti.

units.italian: Mentre esci dalla <ship>, noti che un gruppo di Successori in uniforme è schierato sull'attenti sulla piazzola. L'ufficiale di testa ti si avvicina e ti consegna una piccola sfera metallica molto simile al dispositivo-mappa che ti era stato offerto prima. Invece di proiettare una mappa, però, la sfera comincia a riprodurre una registrazione appena la tocchi.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2 Prompt|	"Captain <first> <last>! I've been instructed to inform thee that our most honored scions of noble House Sioeora want that thou woulds't before them appear to render 'them thy service and thine aid. They, hm... demand that thee make haste to our fair world once more, and prepare thyself as pleaseth thou for an audience before them. In confirmation of this message, I do myself attest: Vijaat Ojniis Sieasej, an honored scholar of the third iret in service to our noble House."|222|0
units.english: "Captain <first> <last>! I've been instructed to inform thee that our most honored scions of noble House Sioeora want that thou woulds't before them appear to render 'them thy service and thine aid. They, hm... demand that thee make haste to our fair world once more, and prepare thyself as pleaseth thou for an audience before them. In confirmation of this message, I do myself attest: Vijaat Ojniis Sieasej, an honored scholar of the third iret in service to our noble House."
units.italian: "Capitano <first> <last>! Ho l'incarico di informarti che i nostri onoratissimi eredi della nobile Casa Sioeora desiderano che tu ti presenti davanti a loro per prestare a loro il tuo servizio e il tuo aiuto. Essi, hm... esigono che tu ti affretti di nuovo verso il nostro bel mondo, e che ti prepari come meglio ti aggrada a un'udienza davanti a loro. A conferma di questo messaggio, io stesso attesto: Vijaat Ojniis Sieasej, onorato studioso del terzo iret al servizio della nostra nobile Casa."

units.english: Soon after you enter the atmosphere of <planet>, the <ship> is flanked by a pair of interceptors which lead you to a sprawling complex in the northern hemisphere at the edge of a large lake. Your escorts set down on two small landing pads near the shore, and you see that another landing pad between them has been lit up in colors matching the livery of your ship.
units.italian: Poco dopo essere entrato nell'atmosfera di <planet>, la <ship> viene affiancata da due intercettori che ti guidano verso un complesso esteso nell'emisfero settentrionale, sul bordo di un grande lago. Le tue scorte si posano su due piccole piazzole vicine alla riva, e vedi che un'altra piazzola tra le due è stata illuminata con colori che corrispondono alla livrea della tua nave.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	As before, your landing site has been surrounded by a cadre of uniformed individuals, but this time there must be nearly a hundred standing at attention on the pad's perimeter, of which most appear heavily armed. Once again upon disembarking, a lead officer approaches you, accompanied by a group of eight others who follow them in a tight formation. The leader motions with one of their arms towards the center of the complex as if to instruct you to go.|238|0
units.english: As before, your landing site has been surrounded by a cadre of uniformed individuals, but this time there must be nearly a hundred standing at attention on the pad's perimeter, of which most appear heavily armed. Once again upon disembarking, a lead officer approaches you, accompanied by a group of eight others who follow them in a tight formation. The leader motions with one of their arms towards the center of the complex as if to instruct you to go.
units.italian: Come prima, il luogo del tuo atterraggio è circondato da un gruppo di individui in uniforme, ma questa volta ce ne sono quasi un centinaio sull'attenti lungo il perimetro della piazzola, e la maggior parte sembra pesantemente armata. Anche questa volta, appena sbarchi, un ufficiale di testa ti si avvicina, accompagnato da un gruppo di otto che lo segue in formazione serrata. Il capo fa un gesto con uno dei bracci verso il centro del complesso, come per ordinarti di andare.

units.italian: L'individuo di testa ti studia e fa scorrere un po' i bracci, poi ripete il gesto verso il centro del complesso.

units.italian: Il capo dice qualcosa a uno degli altri, poi riporta l'attenzione su di te e fa di nuovo un gesto, questa volta con l'arma.

units.italian: La tua scorta si rilassa mentre ti muovi verso il complesso interno, e il gruppo di otto ti segue mentre ti avvicini alle porte esterne.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	The inside of the complex is opulent and massive, with vaulted ceilings rising on columns out of the lake water. Some mimic the forms and textures of tree trunks, spreading out on the ceiling into a canopy filled with thin metallic leaves that slowly wave and occlude the lights embedded above them. Each successive hall you pass through is a unique and enormous sculpture: the arch of a wave moments before crashing; the spiral of a huge suckered arm. You eventually arrive at a large door that your escort extends an arm to touch. As soon as they do, it begins to liquefy and flow into a trench on the floor. When it is finished, you step across the threshold into a final circular room where a group of Successors stand waiting. You recognize one as Sieasej, now wearing a new set of metallic-looking robes, but the rest are unfamiliar and are especially richly dressed.|253|0
units.english: The inside of the complex is opulent and massive, with vaulted ceilings rising on columns out of the lake water. Some mimic the forms and textures of tree trunks, spreading out on the ceiling into a canopy filled with thin metallic leaves that slowly wave and occlude the lights embedded above them. Each successive hall you pass through is a unique and enormous sculpture: the arch of a wave moments before crashing; the spiral of a huge suckered arm. You eventually arrive at a large door that your escort extends an arm to touch. As soon as they do, it begins to liquefy and flow into a trench on the floor. When it is finished, you step across the threshold into a final circular room where a group of Successors stand waiting. You recognize one as Sieasej, now wearing a new set of metallic-looking robes, but the rest are unfamiliar and are especially richly dressed.
units.italian: L'interno del complesso è opulento e immenso, con soffitti a volta che si innalzano su colonne uscite dall'acqua del lago. Alcune imitano forme e consistenze di tronchi e si aprono sul soffitto in una volta di foglie metalliche sottili che ondeggiano piano e coprono le luci incassate sopra di esse. Ogni sala che attraversi è una scultura unica ed enorme: l'arco di un'onda un attimo prima di infrangersi; la spirale di un enorme braccio munito di ventose. Arrivi infine a una grande porta che la tua scorta tocca con un braccio. Appena lo fa, la porta comincia a liquefarsi e a fluire in un canale nel pavimento. Quando ha finito, varchi la soglia in un'ultima stanza circolare dove un gruppo di Successori aspetta in piedi. Ne riconosci uno: è Sieasej, ora con nuove vesti dall'aspetto metallico; gli altri ti sono estranei e sono vestiti in modo particolarmente ricco.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	One of the adorned individuals looks at you and speaks, and Sieasej translates a moment later.|254|0
units.english: One of the adorned individuals looks at you and speaks, and Sieasej translates a moment later.
units.italian: Uno degli individui adorni ti guarda e parla, e un momento dopo Sieasej traduce.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"Hail, captain! We appreciate thy promptness in complying 'thour request. I am Riijaaora, an honored scion of House Sioeora. I shall speak for today for my fellows and the House."|257|0
units.english: "Hail, captain! We appreciate thy promptness in complying 'thour request. I am Riijaaora, an honored scion of House Sioeora. I shall speak for today for my fellows and the House."
units.italian: "Salve, capitano! Apprezziamo la tua sollecitudine nell'ottemperare alla nostra richiesta. Sono Riijaaora, onorato erede di Casa Sioeora. Parlerò oggi per i miei compagni e per la Casa."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"Hail, captain! Thy tardiness reflects poorly upon thee. I am Riijaaora, an honored Scion of House Sioeora. I shall speak for today for my fellows and the House."|260|0
units.english: "Hail, captain! Thy tardiness reflects poorly upon thee. I am Riijaaora, an honored Scion of House Sioeora. I shall speak for today for my fellows and the House."
units.italian: "Salve, capitano! Il tuo ritardo parla male di te. Sono Riijaaora, onorato erede di Casa Sioeora. Parlerò oggi per i miei compagni e per la Casa."

units.english: "I do not appreciate being bossed around."
units.italian: "Non apprezzo che mi si dia ordini."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"'Tis a world within the scar of shrouded systems to the north th'twas once by name Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. We require thee to visit there, where'pon its surface, thou shall'st go and find a certain beast t'return to us, undamaged and unspoil't. The scholar, Sieasej, shall escort thee: an envoy of this House t'assist and monitor thine efforts. And if thou'rt successful in the fetching of thine quarry, we shall see fit to thee bestow the peerless gift of language, so that thou might'st not evermore require the use of a translator, as doth thou, here and now."|286|0
units.english: "'Tis a world within the scar of shrouded systems to the north th'twas once by name Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. We require thee to visit there, where'pon its surface, thou shall'st go and find a certain beast t'return to us, undamaged and unspoil't. The scholar, Sieasej, shall escort thee: an envoy of this House t'assist and monitor thine efforts. And if thou'rt successful in the fetching of thine quarry, we shall see fit to thee bestow the peerless gift of language, so that thou might'st not evermore require the use of a translator, as doth thou, here and now."
units.italian: "È un mondo dentro la cicatrice di sistemi avvolti dalla foschia, a nord, che un tempo aveva il nome di Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. Ti chiediamo di andare là e, sulla sua superficie, di cercare una certa bestia e di riportarcela, integra e non guastata. Lo studioso Sieasej ti scorterà: un inviato di questa Casa che assisterà e sorveglierà i tuoi sforzi. E se riuscirai a recuperare la preda, riterremo opportuno concederti il dono impareggiabile della lingua, così che tu non debba mai più ricorrere a un traduttore, come fai qui e ora."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"I accept."|288|0
units.english: "I accept."
units.italian: "Accetto."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"You want me to do your errands? I won't!"|290|0
units.english: "You want me to do your errands? I won't!"
units.italian: "Vuoi che faccia le tue commissioni? Non ci penso!"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"The one who speaks these words to thee know'th well the value language doth confer, and we suspect 'tis true that thee knoweth this as well. There's a world within the scar of shrouded systems to the north th'twas once by name Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. We require thee to visit there, where'pon its surface, thou shall'st go and find a certain beast t'return to us, undamaged and unspoil't. The scholar, Sieasej, shall escort thee: an envoy of this House t'assist and monitor thine efforts. units.english: "The one who speaks these words to thee know'th well the value language doth confer, and we suspect 'tis true that thee knoweth this as well. There's a world within the scar of shrouded systems to the north th'twas once by name Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. We require thee to visit there, where'pon its surface, thou shall'st go and find a certain beast t'return to us, undamaged and unspoil't. The scholar, Sieasej, shall escort thee: an envoy of this House t'assist and monitor thine efforts. And if thou'rt successful in the fetching of thine quarry, thou shall'st have our reward of language and all that it bestows."
units.italian: "Chi ti rivolge queste parole conosce bene il valore che la lingua conferisce, e sospettiamo che anche tu lo sappia. C'è un mondo dentro la cicatrice di sistemi avvolti dalla foschia, a nord, che un tempo aveva il nome di Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. Ti chiediamo di andare là e, sulla sua superficie, di cercare una certa bestia e di riportarcela, integra e non guastata. Lo studioso Sieasej ti scorterà: un inviato di questa Casa che assisterà e sorveglierà i tuoi sforzi. E se riuscirai a recuperare la preda, avrai da noi la ricompensa della lingua e tutto ciò che essa conferisce."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"I accept."|295|0
units.english: "I accept."
units.italian: "Accetto."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"You want me to do your errands? I won't!"|297|0
units.english: "You want me to do your errands? I won't!"
units.italian: "Vuoi che faccia le tue commissioni? Non ci penso!"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"Thine appreciation, or thy failure t'appreciate, are not the sort of things that would concern us in this hall. Thou may'st be an alien, still swaddled in thine ignorance, and yet this makes thee even more a guest upon our worlds and, hm... consumer of our grace. Thy compliance is expected; in return, our generosity."|300|0
units.english: "Thine appreciation, or thy failure t'appreciate, are not the sort of things that would concern us in this hall. Thou may'st be an alien, still swaddled in thine ignorance, and yet this makes thee even more a guest upon our worlds and, hm... consumer of our grace. Thy compliance is expected; in return, our generosity."
units.italian: "Il tuo apprezzamento, o la tua incapacità di apprezzare, non sono cose che ci riguardino in questa sala. Puoi essere un alieno, ancora avvolto nella tua ignoranza, e proprio questo ti rende ancor più ospite sui nostri mondi e, hm... fruitore della nostra grazia. La tua obbedienza è attesa; in cambio, la nostra generosità."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"I apologize."|302|0
units.english: "I apologize."
units.italian: "Chiedo scusa."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"I have no desire to be your servant."|303|0
units.english: "I have no desire to be your servant."
units.italian: "Non ho alcun desiderio di essere il tuo servo."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"Thine apology is noted."|305|0
units.english: "Thine apology is noted."
units.italian: "La tua scusa è presa in nota."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|log|309|0
units.english: Met with the leaders of the Successor High House Sioeora and was instructed to retrieve an animal from the planet Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. Was promised translation equipment as a reward. Accepted their offer.
units.italian: Hai incontrato i capi della Casa Alta Sioeora dei Successori e ti è stato ordinato di recuperare un animale dal pianeta Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. Ti è stato promesso un dispositivo di traduzione come ricompensa. Hai accettato la loro offerta.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	"Thou show'st wisdom in thy choice. Even now, thy ship is being prepared within the spaceport o'this estate. Thou should'st travel there when thine audience is finished, and there begin thy noble task with haste." The scion pauses for a moment before continuing. "But prithee note, dear Captain..." Sieasej shivers with color as the scion speaks the next sentence, "that we do not entrust our citizen to thee 'thout consideration. If harm befalls the speaker of these words whilst under thy protection, or if thou fail'st t'return them here in thirty days, we will consider thee an enemy and levy upon thee every harm that we can muster."|310|0
units.english: "Thou show'st wisdom in thy choice. Even now, thy ship is being prepared within the spaceport o'this estate. Thou should'st travel there when thine audience is finished, and there begin thy noble task with haste." The scion pauses for a moment before continuing. "But prithee note, dear Captain..." Sieasej shivers with color as the scion speaks the next sentence, "that we do not entrust our citizen to thee 'thout consideration. If harm befalls the speaker of these words whilst under thy protection, or if thou fail'st t'return them here in thirty days, we will consider thee an enemy and levy upon thee every harm that we can muster."
units.italian: "Mostri saggezza nella tua scelta. Già ora la tua nave viene preparata nello spazioporto di questa tenuta. Dovresti recarti là quando la tua udienza sarà finita, e là cominciare senza indugio il tuo nobile compito." L'erede si ferma un momento prima di continuare. "Ma sappi, caro capitano..." Sieasej freme di colore mentre l'erede pronuncia la frase seguente, "che non ti affidiamo un nostro cittadino senza contropartita. Se chi pronuncia queste parole subirà un danno mentre è sotto la tua protezione, o se non ce lo riporterai qui entro trenta giorni, ti considereremo un nemico e ti infliggeremo ogni male che potremo radunare."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|log|314|0
units.english: Met with the leaders of the Successor High House Sioeora and was instructed to retrieve an animal from the planet Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. Was promised translation equipment as a reward. Rejected.
units.italian: Hai incontrato i capi della Casa Alta Sioeora dei Successori e ti è stato ordinato di recuperare un animale dal pianeta Raaqa-Uur-Kaav. Ti è stato promesso un dispositivo di traduzione come ricompensa. Hai rifiutato.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	A ripple of color runs up the body of Sieasej and several of the other Successors. The scion gives their response slowly. "Then our act of grace today shall be t'allow thee to depart this noble place still possessed o'thy freedom and belongings. Thou shalt receive no further aid nor comfort from this House, and shalt be banished at the pleasure of its scions from whatever worlds lie under our dominion."|317|0
units.english: A ripple of color runs up the body of Sieasej and several of the other Successors. The scion gives their response slowly. "Then our act of grace today shall be t'allow thee to depart this noble place still possessed o'thy freedom and belongings. Thou shalt receive no further aid nor comfort from this House, and shalt be banished at the pleasure of its scions from whatever worlds lie under our dominion."
units.italian: Un'increspatura di colore risale il corpo di Sieasej e di diversi altri Successori. L'erede dà la propria risposta lentamente. "Allora il nostro atto di grazia di oggi sarà di permetterti di lasciare questo nobile luogo ancora in possesso della tua libertà e dei tuoi averi. Non riceverai altro aiuto né conforto da questa Casa, e sarai bandito, a piacere dei suoi eredi, da tutti i mondi che stanno sotto il nostro dominio."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	Sieasej and the scions turn their backs to you, and a line of soldiers converge from the walls to form a line separating you from them. The lead officer who escorted you inside motions with their weapon for you to leave.|318|0
units.english: Sieasej and the scions turn their backs to you, and a line of soldiers converge from the walls to form a line separating you from them. The lead officer who escorted you inside motions with their weapon for you to leave.
units.italian: Sieasej e gli eredi ti voltano le spalle, e una fila di soldati converge dalle pareti a formare una linea che ti separa da loro. L'ufficiale di testa che ti ha scortato dentro fa un gesto con l'arma perché tu te ne vada.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 2|	As you exit, the door closes behind you, reforming into solid metal.|319|0
units.english: As you exit, the door closes behind you, reforming into solid metal.
units.italian: Mentre esci, la porta si chiude dietro di te e torna a essere metallo solido.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|name|323|0
units.english: Capture an animal for House Sioeora
units.italian: Cattura un animale per Casa Sioeora

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|description|324|0
units.english: The scions of House Sioeora have instructed you to visit the planet <planet stopovers> and capture a "Kijra-riitaa" to safely return to them at <planet>. Return by <date> or they will consider you to have kidnapped Sieasej.
units.italian: Gli eredi di Casa Sioeora ti hanno ordinato di visitare il pianeta <planet stopovers> e di catturare un "Kijra-riitaa" da riportare loro sano e salvo su <planet>. Torna entro <date>, o considereranno che tu abbia rapito Sieasej.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|blocked|336|0
units.english: You speak with Sieasej, who informs you that they require at least 1 free bunk to travel and 1 ton of cargo space to carry the "Kijra-riitaa" back to Successor space.
units.italian: Parli con Sieasej, che ti informa che gli servono almeno 1 cuccetta libera per viaggiare e 1 tonnellata di spazio cargo per trasportare il "Kijra-riitaa" nello spazio dei Successori.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|You are met in House Sioeora's spaceport by Sieasej, who has shed the adorned metallic robes they wore in the presence of the scions for a more robust and rugged cocoon-like outfit. "Ah, Captain <last>," they say. "Thou conducted thyself well with the scions of the House. Well enough for an alien, at least."|346|0
units.english: You are met in House Sioeora's spaceport by Sieasej, who has shed the adorned metallic robes they wore in the presence of the scions for a more robust and rugged cocoon-like outfit. "Ah, Captain <last>," they say. "Thou conducted thyself well with the scions of the House. Well enough for an alien, at least."
units.italian: Nello spazioporto di Casa Sioeora ti viene incontro Sieasej, che ha lasciato le vesti metalliche adornate indossate alla presenza degli eredi per un abito simile a un bozzolo, più robusto e resistente. "Ah, capitano <last>," dicono. "Ti sei comportato bene con gli eredi della Casa. Abbastanza bene, almeno, per un alieno."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Thank you. What can you tell me about our mission?"|348|0
units.english: "Thank you. What can you tell me about our mission?"
units.italian: "Grazie. Che cosa puoi dirmi della nostra missione?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"What do you mean, 'well enough for an alien?'"|350|0
units.english: "What do you mean, 'well enough for an alien?'"
units.italian: "Che vuoi dire con 'abbastanza bene per un alieno'?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	A ripple of a rough, greenish texture passes over Sieasej's skin before subsiding. "Audiences like that one are subject to a litany of social expectations. If thou were't one of us, then thine ignorance of these things would seem knavish at the least, but... the scions are not fools. They are more than willing to endure a little bit of rudeness for the sake of their aims."|351|0
units.english: A ripple of a rough, greenish texture passes over Sieasej's skin before subsiding. "Audiences like that one are subject to a litany of social expectations. If thou were't one of us, then thine ignorance of these things would seem knavish at the least, but... the scions are not fools. They are more than willing to endure a little bit of rudeness for the sake of their aims."
units.italian: Un'increspatura di consistenza ruvida e verdastra passa sulla pelle di Sieasej prima di attenuarsi. "Udienze come quella sono soggette a una litania di aspettative sociali. Se fossi uno di noi, la tua ignoranza di queste cose sembrerebbe quanto meno villana, ma... gli eredi non sono sciocchi. Sono più che disposti a sopportare un po' di scortesia in nome dei loro obiettivi."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"I see," you say. "I suppose I am too."|352|0
units.english: "I see," you say. "I suppose I am too."
units.italian: "Capisco," dici. "Immagino di non essere da meno."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Fret not," Sieasej says, "for elegance of thine address was neither expected nor required. It's all that has a place and time where's needed, and a place and time where's not."|353|0
units.english: "Fret not," Sieasej says, "for elegance of thine address was neither expected nor required. It's all that has a place and time where's needed, and a place and time where's not."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti," dice Sieasej, "perché l'eleganza del tuo parlare non era né attesa né richiesta. Ogni cosa ha un luogo e un tempo in cui serve, e un luogo e un tempo in cui non serve."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	Sieasej shuffles their arms beneath them. "Ah. I must again speak on behalf of Sioeora." They produce another metallic data-sphere from a pouch on their outfit and offer it to you. "This sphere shall thee provide a marker for the system we're to journey to. On the second planet's second moon, we are to land and find a Kijra-riitaa, a Kijra-'pet,' a beast of sorts, as the scions told thee prior in thine audience with them."|355|0
units.english: Sieasej shuffles their arms beneath them. "Ah. I must again speak on behalf of Sioeora." They produce another metallic data-sphere from a pouch on their outfit and offer it to you. "This sphere shall thee provide a marker for the system we're to journey to. On the second planet's second moon, we are to land and find a Kijra-riitaa, a Kijra-'pet,' a beast of sorts, as the scions told thee prior in thine audience with them."
units.italian: Sieasej fa scorrere i bracci sotto di sé. "Ah. Devo di nuovo parlare a nome di Sioeora." Estrae da una tasca del proprio abito un'altra sfera di dati metallica e te la offre. "Questa sfera ti darà il segnaposto del sistema verso cui dobbiamo andare. Sulla seconda luna del secondo pianeta dobbiamo atterrare e trovare un Kijra-riitaa, un Kijra-'pet', una sorta di bestia, come gli eredi ti hanno detto prima, nella tua udienza con loro."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"We'd better get started, then."|358|0
units.english: "We'd better get started, then."
units.italian: "Meglio cominciare, allora."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"What did you mean that jump drives are 'familiar?'"|360|0
units.english: "What did you mean that jump drives are 'familiar?'"
units.italian: "Che volevi dire che i motori di salto vi sono 'familiari'?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Do the scions have their own jump drives?"|365|0
units.english: "Do the scions have their own jump drives?"
units.italian: "Gli eredi hanno motori di salto propri?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"What more can you tell me about these Kijra-pets?"|370|0
units.english: "What more can you tell me about these Kijra-pets?"
units.italian: "Che altro puoi dirmi di questi Kijra-pet?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"How does Sioeora even know that the Kijra-pets are on this moon?"|374|0
units.english: "How does Sioeora even know that the Kijra-pets are on this moon?"
units.italian: "Come fa Sioeora a sapere che i Kijra-pet sono su questa luna?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Are you certain you're okay going with me?"|378|0
units.english: "Are you certain you're okay going with me?"
units.italian: "Sei certo che ti vada bene venire con me?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Is there anything I should watch out for?"|382|0
units.english: "Is there anything I should watch out for?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa a cui dovrei stare attento?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	Sieasej shivers a little, and chooses their words slowly. "The Kijran are quite well-discussed in the history of our people. 'Twere favored pets and hunting beasts among... a few of our Predecessors in their time. The larva is the scale of a... hm, of thy head, though, give or take; with a delicate body and glassy skin, and wings of finest silk. But if it mates and lays its eggs, it gives itself some sundry molts till'ts larger and more fearsome to defend its nascent brood. The Kijran-Riitaa - the Kijra-'pets' - are the young of these, and the Kijran-Khora the dread adults. If thou art wise," Sieasej emphasizes this with a wave of color, "thou shoulds't capture the young and nothing else."|389|0
units.english: Sieasej shivers a little, and chooses their words slowly. "The Kijran are quite well-discussed in the history of our people. 'Twere favored pets and hunting beasts among... a few of our Predecessors in their time. The larva is the scale of a... hm, of thy head, though, give or take; with a delicate body and glassy skin, and wings of finest silk. But if it mates and lays its eggs, it gives itself some sundry molts till'ts larger and more fearsome to defend its nascent brood. The Kijran-Riitaa - the Kijra-'pets' - are the young of these, and the Kijran-Khora the dread adults. If thou art wise," Sieasej emphasizes this with a wave of color, "thou shoulds't capture the young and nothing else."
units.italian: Sieasej freme un poco e sceglie le parole lentamente. "I Kijran sono molto discussi nella storia del nostro popolo. Erano animali domestici e bestie da caccia prediletti tra... alcune delle nostre genti dei Predecessori, ai loro tempi. La larva è della misura di una... hm, della tua testa, più o meno; con un corpo delicato e una pelle di vetro, e ali di seta finissima. Ma se si accoppia e depone le uova, si sottopone a diverse mute finché non diventa più grande e più temibile per difendere la covata nascente. I Kijran-Riitaa, i Kijra-'pet', sono i piccoli di questi, e i Kijran-Khora gli adulti temuti. Se sei saggio," Sieasej sottolinea questo con un'onda di colore, "dovresti catturare i piccoli e nient'altro."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"'Tis a mix of things," Sieasej says. "The... paths in space which connect those stars are ever-changing, year by year. A hazard of the space. Some years ago, t'was a pathway leading to it through which craft of all the Houses could find passage and explore. Now, it's been closed for many years and our vessels may not enter. The scions know thou must possess a jump drive in order for thou t'ave reach'd us here, for this technology's a familiar one to us. And so they know thou cans't retrieve that thing which they desire."|394|0
units.english: "'Tis a mix of things," Sieasej says. "The... paths in space which connect those stars are ever-changing, year by year. A hazard of the space. Some years ago, t'was a pathway leading to it through which craft of all the Houses could find passage and explore. Now, it's been closed for many years and our vessels may not enter. The scions know thou must possess a jump drive in order for thou t'ave reach'd us here, for this technology's a familiar one to us. And so they know thou cans't retrieve that thing which they desire."
units.italian: "È un insieme di cose," dice Sieasej. "I... percorsi nello spazio che collegano quelle stelle cambiano continuamente, anno dopo anno. È un rischio di quello spazio. Qualche anno fa c'era un percorso che conduceva fin là, attraverso il quale le navi di tutte le Casate potevano trovare passaggio ed esplorare. Ora è chiuso da molti anni e i nostri vascelli non possono entrarvi. Gli eredi sanno che devi possedere un motore di salto perché tu sia potuto arrivare fino a noi, perché questa tecnologia ci è familiare. E così sanno che puoi recuperare quella cosa che desiderano."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|396|0
units.english: jump drives
units.italian: jump drives

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Remember, Captain, our Predecessors did ply the stars for ten thousand years before we last set eyes on thine own race, who then had only just discovered industry. Drives like the one within thy ship have been known to us for long into thy past."|399|0
units.english: "Remember, Captain, our Predecessors did ply the stars for ten thousand years before we last set eyes on thine own race, who then had only just discovered industry. Drives like the one within thy ship have been known to us for long into thy past."
units.italian: "Ricorda, capitano, che i nostri Predecessori solcarono le stelle per diecimila anni prima che noi posassimo di nuovo gli occhi sulla tua specie, che allora aveva appena scoperto l'industria. Motori come quello della tua nave ci sono noti da molto prima del tuo passato."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"That is not for me to know, nor, I think, for thee."|404|0
units.english: "That is not for me to know, nor, I think, for thee."
units.italian: "Questo non sta a me saperlo, né, credo, a te."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|406|0
units.english: you okay
units.italian: you okay

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	Splotches of orange color emerge at the tips of Sieasej's arms. "I confess this is a little strange, and know the prospect of this... journey instills within me some thoughts of trepidation. But to visit these worlds is reward itself, and to do so in thy company, the very aliens who I have studied, makes it a reward that's doubly grand. Thou must realize that thou'rt a historian's dream. Thou'rt a creature from a distant story-page made flesh and blood in the modern age."|409|0
units.english: Splotches of orange color emerge at the tips of Sieasej's arms. "I confess this is a little strange, and know the prospect of this... journey instills within me some thoughts of trepidation. But to visit these worlds is reward itself, and to do so in thy company, the very aliens who I have studied, makes it a reward that's doubly grand. Thou must realize that thou'rt a historian's dream. Thou'rt a creature from a distant story-page made flesh and blood in the modern age."
units.italian: Macchie di colore arancione emergono sulle punte dei bracci di Sieasej. "Confesso che questo è un po' strano, e so che la prospettiva di questo... viaggio mi suscita qualche pensiero di trepidazione. Ma visitare quei mondi è già di per sé una ricompensa, e farlo in tua compagnia, proprio degli alieni che ho studiato, la rende doppiamente grande. Devi renderti conto che sei il sogno di uno storico. Sei una creatura uscita da una pagina di una storia lontana, fatta carne e sangue nell'età moderna."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|411|0
units.english: watch out
units.italian: watch out

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"The House hast warned me of the dangers which that space entails. Thy vessel must've endured enough to make it here intact, so I must trust that it shall be enduring once again."|414|0
units.english: "The House hast warned me of the dangers which that space entails. Thy vessel must've endured enough to make it here intact, so I must trust that it shall be enduring once again."
units.italian: "La Casa mi ha avvertito dei pericoli che quello spazio comporta. La tua nave deve aver resistito abbastanza da arrivare qui intatta, quindi devo fidarmi che resisterà ancora."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"I agree," Sieasej says. "We have no time to squander."|424|0
units.english: "I agree," Sieasej says. "We have no time to squander."
units.italian: "Sono d'accordo," dice Sieasej. "Non abbiamo tempo da sprecare."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|Some minutes after you enter the system, Sieasej enters your ship's cockpit and directs you to a location in the planet's southern hemisphere, on the edge of one of the smaller continents. "Here, captain," they say, "'twas a place where once the beasts were bred. When last our vessels traveled here, 'twas this location where they noted many Kijran-Riitaa."|428|0
units.english: Some minutes after you enter the system, Sieasej enters your ship's cockpit and directs you to a location in the planet's southern hemisphere, on the edge of one of the smaller continents. "Here, captain," they say, "'twas a place where once the beasts were bred. When last our vessels traveled here, 'twas this location where they noted many Kijran-Riitaa."
units.italian: Alcuni minuti dopo che sei entrato nel sistema, Sieasej entra nella cabina di pilotaggio e ti indica un punto nell'emisfero meridionale del pianeta, sul bordo di uno dei continenti minori. "Qui, capitano," dicono, "c'era un luogo dove un tempo le bestie venivano allevate. L'ultima volta che le nostre navi vennero qui, fu in questo punto che ne notarono molti di Kijran-Riitaa."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	As you approach the coordinates to land, you see that it contains the remains of a substantial complex; over a dozen large buildings and several disused landing pads are present, connected by paths of smooth, untarnished metal. The materials show a curious quality of being both unblemished and overgrown - vines cling to otherwise-spotless walls, and the various walkways, though often shaded by large plants, do not show any debris or detritus on their surfaces.|429|0
units.english: As you approach the coordinates to land, you see that it contains the remains of a substantial complex; over a dozen large buildings and several disused landing pads are present, connected by paths of smooth, untarnished metal. The materials show a curious quality of being both unblemished and overgrown - vines cling to otherwise-spotless walls, and the various walkways, though often shaded by large plants, do not show any debris or detritus on their surfaces.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini alle coordinate per atterrare, vedi che contengono i resti di un complesso notevole: ci sono più di una dozzina di grandi edifici e diverse piazzole in disuso, collegate da sentieri di metallo liscio e intatto. I materiali mostrano una qualità curiosa, insieme immacolata e invasa dalla vegetazione: viticci si aggrappano a pareti per il resto senza macchia, e i vari camminamenti, benché spesso ombreggiati da grandi piante, non mostrano detriti sulle loro superfici.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You set the <ship> down on one of the landing pads and exit onto the surface, though not before retrieving a net from storage. You are accompanied by Sieasej, who holds aloft a cylindrical device which they wave in the air for several seconds. "It hears calls of the creatures on the wind, gentler than our ears would notice. So we're fortunate, captain. We will not have to travel far." They wave their device around some more, making slower but wider motions, before they eventually speak again. "The nearest among them lies to the west, a little distance along the path."|434|0
units.english: You set the <ship> down on one of the landing pads and exit onto the surface, though not before retrieving a net from storage. You are accompanied by Sieasej, who holds aloft a cylindrical device which they wave in the air for several seconds. "It hears calls of the creatures on the wind, gentler than our ears would notice. So we're fortunate, captain. We will not have to travel far." They wave their device around some more, making slower but wider motions, before they eventually speak again. "The nearest among them lies to the west, a little distance along the path."
units.italian: Posi la <ship> su una delle piazzole ed esci sulla superficie, non prima di aver recuperato una rete dalla stiva. Ti accompagna Sieasej, che tiene sollevato un dispositivo cilindrico e lo agita nell'aria per diversi secondi. "Percepisce i richiami delle creature nel vento, più tenui di quanto le nostre orecchie noterebbero. Siamo fortunati, capitano. Non dovremo andare lontano." Agita ancora il dispositivo, con movimenti più lenti ma più ampi, prima di parlare di nuovo. "Il più vicino è a ovest, a poca distanza lungo il sentiero."
