units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Approach the location.)|440|0
units.english: (Approach the location.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati al luogo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"You know a lot about tracking for a scholar."|442|0
units.english: "You know a lot about tracking for a scholar."
units.italian: "Sai molto di tracciamento, per essere uno studioso."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Ah," Sieasej says, pausing for a moment. "A product of some training I've not used in many years. Perhaps Sioeora's forward-thinking as much as they'd have us believe."|443|0
units.english: "Ah," Sieasej says, pausing for a moment. "A product of some training I've not used in many years. Perhaps Sioeora's forward-thinking as much as they'd have us believe."
units.italian: "Ah," dice Sieasej, fermandosi un momento. "Frutto di un addestramento che non uso da molti anni. Forse Sioeora è lungimirante quanto vorrebbe farci credere."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You make your way along one of the walkways to the west, brushing aside the enormous leaves of the overgrowing plants. Sieasej continues to wave their triangulation device in the air and quietly relays your progress; as you get closer, you hear a gentle scuffling that you realize precedes every detection by the device. After making your way through one particularly-dense wall of flora, you spot your target: a glassy-winged animal perched in a plant over the walkway's edge, probing the branch it stands on with long feelers extending from its head.|445|0
units.english: You make your way along one of the walkways to the west, brushing aside the enormous leaves of the overgrowing plants. Sieasej continues to wave their triangulation device in the air and quietly relays your progress; as you get closer, you hear a gentle scuffling that you realize precedes every detection by the device. After making your way through one particularly-dense wall of flora, you spot your target: a glassy-winged animal perched in a plant over the walkway's edge, probing the branch it stands on with long feelers extending from its head.
units.italian: Ti fai strada lungo uno dei camminamenti verso ovest, scostando le foglie enormi delle piante invadenti. Sieasej continua ad agitare il dispositivo di triangolazione e a riferire piano i tuoi progressi; man mano che ti avvicini, senti un fruscio leggero che capisci precedere ogni rilevamento del dispositivo. Dopo aver attraversato una parete di vegetazione particolarmente fitta, scorci il tuo bersaglio: un animale dalle ali di vetro appollaiato su una pianta oltre il bordo del camminamento, che saggia il ramo su cui sta con lunghe antenne che si protendono dalla testa.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Try to tranquilize it.)|447|0
units.english: (Try to tranquilize it.)
units.italian: (Prova a tranquillizzarlo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Try to catch it with a net.)|453|0
units.english: (Try to catch it with a net.)
units.italian: (Prova a catturarlo con una rete.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Stay still and try to capture it without aggression.)|455|0
units.english: (Stay still and try to capture it without aggression.)
units.italian: (Resta fermo e prova a catturarlo senza aggressività.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You take aim and fire a blast from the <tranq h2h> at the animal, but it darts away at the last moment so that the blast only just grazes its body. It plummets to the ground shrieking, and while it soon goes quiet as the tranquilizer takes effect, the shriek is echoed by other animals in the area. Soon after those quiet as well, your ears are pierced by a loud, warbling wail from the distance.|460|0
units.english: You take aim and fire a blast from the <tranq h2h> at the animal, but it darts away at the last moment so that the blast only just grazes its body. It plummets to the ground shrieking, and while it soon goes quiet as the tranquilizer takes effect, the shriek is echoed by other animals in the area. Soon after those quiet as well, your ears are pierced by a loud, warbling wail from the distance.
units.italian: Miri e spari un colpo della <tranq h2h> contro l'animale, ma all'ultimo momento quello scatta via, così che il colpo lo sfiora appena. Crolla al suolo strillando, e anche se presto tace mentre il tranquillante fa effetto, lo strillo è riecheggiato da altri animali della zona. Poco dopo anche quelli tacciono, e le tue orecchie sono trafitte da un lungo lamento tremolante in lontananza.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You take aim and fire a blast from the <tranq h2h> at the center of the animal. It briefly jumps to escape but soon plummets to the ground in a puff of leaves and dusty feathers.|463|0
units.english: You take aim and fire a blast from the <tranq h2h> at the center of the animal. It briefly jumps to escape but soon plummets to the ground in a puff of leaves and dusty feathers.
units.italian: Miri e spari un colpo della <tranq h2h> al centro dell'animale. Salta per un istante nel tentativo di fuggire, ma presto crolla al suolo in una nuvola di foglie e piume impolverate.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You toss a net over the animal and it falls to the ground, where it shrieks for a duration before going quiet. The shriek is soon echoed by similar ones from other animals in the area, and once those go quiet as well, your ears are pierced by a loud, warbling wail in the distance.|466|0
units.english: You toss a net over the animal and it falls to the ground, where it shrieks for a duration before going quiet. The shriek is soon echoed by similar ones from other animals in the area, and once those go quiet as well, your ears are pierced by a loud, warbling wail in the distance.
units.italian: Lanci una rete sull'animale, che cade a terra e strilla per un po' prima di tacere. Lo strillo è presto riecheggiato da altri simili provenienti da altri animali della zona, e quando anche quelli tacciono, le tue orecchie sono trafitte da un lungo lamento tremolante in lontananza.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	The animal remains stationary as well, examining you closely. Its eyes are large and furtive, with bright red irises and the same hourglass-shaped pupils as the Successors. After it looks you over, it eventually approaches your hand, sniffing it gently and brushing its downy forelimbs against your skin.|469|0
units.english: The animal remains stationary as well, examining you closely. Its eyes are large and furtive, with bright red irises and the same hourglass-shaped pupils as the Successors. After it looks you over, it eventually approaches your hand, sniffing it gently and brushing its downy forelimbs against your skin.
units.italian: Anche l'animale resta immobile, esaminandoti da vicino. I suoi occhi sono grandi e furtivi, con iridi di un rosso brillante e le stesse pupille a forma di clessidra dei Successori. Dopo averti studiato, alla fine si avvicina alla tua mano, la annusa piano e sfiora la tua pelle con gli arti anteriori coperti di piumino.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Try to bring it back with food alone.)|471|0
units.english: (Try to bring it back with food alone.)
units.italian: (Prova a portarlo con te solo con del cibo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Tranquilize it now.)|472|0
units.english: (Tranquilize it now.)
units.italian: (Tranquillizzalo ora.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Catch it with a net.)|478|0
units.english: (Catch it with a net.)
units.italian: (Catturalo con una rete.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You retrieve a morsel of food and offer it to the Kijra-pet, which sniffs it extensively before starting to eat, trilling quietly as it takes a couple of small bites. It tucks its wings behind its body like a dragonfly and unfurls two long feather-like antennae from its head, which join its legs in feeling your skin and clothing. Soon, it hops on your arm while sniffing at your pockets, cooing and probing deeper into the one where you kept the food. You begin the walk back to your ship as it continues to explore your pockets, careful to not frighten the animal with any sudden movements.|482|0
units.english: You retrieve a morsel of food and offer it to the Kijra-pet, which sniffs it extensively before starting to eat, trilling quietly as it takes a couple of small bites. It tucks its wings behind its body like a dragonfly and unfurls two long feather-like antennae from its head, which join its legs in feeling your skin and clothing. Soon, it hops on your arm while sniffing at your pockets, cooing and probing deeper into the one where you kept the food. You begin the walk back to your ship as it continues to explore your pockets, careful to not frighten the animal with any sudden movements.
units.italian: Recuperi un boccone di cibo e lo offri al Kijra-pet, che lo annusa a lungo prima di cominciare a mangiare, trillando piano mentre dà un paio di piccoli morsi. Ripiega le ali dietro il corpo come una libellula e distende dalla testa due lunghe antenne simili a piume, che si uniscono alle zampe nell'esplorare la tua pelle e i tuoi vestiti. Presto salta sul tuo braccio annusandoti le tasche, tubando e frugando più a fondo in quella dove tenevi il cibo. Cominci a tornare verso la nave mentre continua a esplorarti le tasche, attento a non spaventarlo con movimenti bruschi.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"'Tis no surprise," Sieasej says, "that 'twere such valued pets if their demeanor is so docile and agreeable." They tuck their triangulation device away in a pocket of their own and slither alongside you.|483|0
units.english: "'Tis no surprise," Sieasej says, "that 'twere such valued pets if their demeanor is so docile and agreeable." They tuck their triangulation device away in a pocket of their own and slither alongside you.
units.italian: "Non c'è da stupirsi," dice Sieasej, "che fossero animali tanto apprezzati, se il loro carattere è così docile e arrendevole." Rimette il dispositivo di triangolazione in una tasca del proprio abito e scivola al tuo fianco.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|485|0

units.english: While the animal is distracted, you take aim and fire a shot from your <tranq h2h> at it. It briefly jumps to escape but soon plummets to the ground in a puff of leaves and dusty feathers.

units.italian: Mentre l'animale è distratto, gli lanci addosso una rete e quello cade a terra, dove strilla per un po' prima di tacere. Lo strillo è presto riecheggiato da altri simili provenienti da altri animali della zona, e quando anche quelli tacciono, le tue orecchie sono trafitte da un lungo lamento tremolante in lontananza.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|491|0
units.english: bring tranq
units.italian: bring tranq

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You scoop up the tranquilized animal, careful not to damage its extremities, and begin the walk back to your ship.|492|0
units.english: You scoop up the tranquilized animal, careful not to damage its extremities, and begin the walk back to your ship.
units.italian: Raccogli l'animale tranquillizzato, attento a non danneggiargli le estremità, e cominci a tornare verso la nave.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Grab it and run!)|496|0
units.english: (Grab it and run!)
units.italian: (Afferralo e corri!)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You scoop up the immobilized animal and begin to run back to your ship as the wailing behind you increases in pitch and intensity. As you and Sieasej dash through the foliage, the sunlight overhead is suddenly darkened by the shadow of something flying overhead.|497|0
units.english: You scoop up the immobilized animal and begin to run back to your ship as the wailing behind you increases in pitch and intensity. As you and Sieasej dash through the foliage, the sunlight overhead is suddenly darkened by the shadow of something flying overhead.
units.italian: Raccogli l'animale immobilizzato e cominci a correre verso la nave mentre il lamento alle tue spalle cresce di tono e intensità. Mentre tu e Sieasej correte tra il fogliame, la luce del sole sopra di voi si oscura all'improvviso per l'ombra di qualcosa che vola sopra le vostre teste.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Keep running.)|499|0
units.english: (Keep running.)
units.italian: (Continua a correre.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Try to shoot at whatever is above me.)|500|0
units.english: (Try to shoot at whatever is above me.)
units.italian: (Prova a sparare a qualunque cosa ci sia sopra di me.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	Suddenly, the shadow disappears and the wailing stops. You keep running towards your ship, but can't shake the feeling that you are being watched.|502|0
units.english: Suddenly, the shadow disappears and the wailing stops. You keep running towards your ship, but can't shake the feeling that you are being watched.
units.italian: Improvvisamente l'ombra sparisce e il lamento cessa. Continui a correre verso la nave, ma non riesci a scrollarti di dosso la sensazione di essere osservato.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|504|0
units.english: shoot ambush
units.italian: shoot ambush

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You draw your sidearm and look to see what's above you, but the shadow is suddenly gone and you are left staring up into the sunlight and leaves. The wailing has stopped as well; indeed, the whole area remains eerily quiet as you continue to run towards your ship.|505|0
units.english: You draw your sidearm and look to see what's above you, but the shadow is suddenly gone and you are left staring up into the sunlight and leaves. The wailing has stopped as well; indeed, the whole area remains eerily quiet as you continue to run towards your ship.
units.italian: Estrai l'arma da fianco e guardi in alto per vedere cosa ci sia, ma l'ombra è sparita all'improvviso e resti a fissare la luce del sole e le foglie. Anche il lamento è cessato; anzi, tutta la zona resta stranamente silenziosa mentre continui a correre verso la nave.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	When you arrive, however, you find that blocking your entry to the <ship> are two large creatures. Their glassy skin resembles that of the smaller creature you captured, but they are each several meters in size. Their feelers, rather than soft and downy, are whiplike and serrated and tipped with vicious-looking barbs that they thrust towards you and Sieasej upon noticing your presence. Their many eyes flick back and forth between you and the animal that you captured, and the two let out a loud wail in unison. Waves of red and blue run down Sieasej's body, probably an expression of fear.|507|0
units.english: When you arrive, however, you find that blocking your entry to the <ship> are two large creatures. Their glassy skin resembles that of the smaller creature you captured, but they are each several meters in size. Their feelers, rather than soft and downy, are whiplike and serrated and tipped with vicious-looking barbs that they thrust towards you and Sieasej upon noticing your presence. Their many eyes flick back and forth between you and the animal that you captured, and the two let out a loud wail in unison. Waves of red and blue run down Sieasej's body, probably an expression of fear.
units.italian: Quando arrivi, però, trovi due grosse creature che ti bloccano l'ingresso alla <ship>. La loro pelle di vetro somiglia a quella della creatura più piccola che hai catturato, ma sono grandi diversi metri ciascuna. Le loro antenne, invece che morbide e piumate, sono simili a fruste e seghettate, con la punta armata di barbigli dall'aria feroce, che protendono verso di te e verso Sieasej appena notano la vostra presenza. I loro molti occhi guizzano tra te e l'animale che hai catturato, e le due emettono all'unisono un lamento acuto. Onde di rosso e blu scorrono sul corpo di Sieasej: probabilmente un'espressione di paura.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Run past them.)|509|0
units.english: (Run past them.)
units.italian: (Corri oltre.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Shoot them with my sidearm.)|510|0
units.english: (Shoot them with my sidearm.)
units.italian: (Sparagli con l'arma da fianco.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Order my crew to fire a turret at them.)|512|0
units.english: (Order my crew to fire a turret at them.)
units.italian: (Ordina al mio equipaggio di sparare con una torretta.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Release the animal that I captured.)|517|0
units.english: (Release the animal that I captured.)
units.italian: (Libera l'animale che ho catturato.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You attempt to run past the creatures, but before you can even get close, one of them swings its barbed feeler at you, lodging it deep in your chest. The last thing you see is Sieasej hurrying away as the creatures pursue them as well.|519|0
units.english: You attempt to run past the creatures, but before you can even get close, one of them swings its barbed feeler at you, lodging it deep in your chest. The last thing you see is Sieasej hurrying away as the creatures pursue them as well.
units.italian: Tenti di correre oltre le creature, ma prima ancora che tu possa avvicinarti, una di loro ti sferza con l'antenna munita di barbigli, conficcandotela in profondità nel petto. L'ultima cosa che vedi è Sieasej che si allontana in fretta mentre le creature inseguono anche loro.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You draw your sidearm and fire at the creatures, striking one in its midsection. It crumples, and immediately after the other one charges at you. Just in time, you are able to shoot that one as well and it tumbles to the ground, kicking up dirt and leaf litter and wailing before going silent.|522|0
units.english: You draw your sidearm and fire at the creatures, striking one in its midsection. It crumples, and immediately after the other one charges at you. Just in time, you are able to shoot that one as well and it tumbles to the ground, kicking up dirt and leaf litter and wailing before going silent.
units.italian: Estrai l'arma da fianco e spari alle creature, colpendone una a metà del corpo. Quella si accascia, e subito dopo l'altra ti carica. Appena in tempo, riesci a sparare anche a quella, che ruzzola al suolo sollevando terra e foglie morte e lanciando un lamento prima di tacere.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|524|0
units.english: ship shoot
units.italian: ship shoot

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You radio to the <ship> and order your crew to fire a turret at the creatures. The power of starship weapons fired at such close range is enough to quickly and unceremoniously dispatch the pair before they have the opportunity to attack.|525|0
units.english: You radio to the <ship> and order your crew to fire a turret at the creatures. The power of starship weapons fired at such close range is enough to quickly and unceremoniously dispatch the pair before they have the opportunity to attack.
units.italian: Chiami la <ship> via radio e ordini al tuo equipaggio di sparare una torretta contro le creature. La potenza delle armi di una nave spaziale a una distanza così ravvicinata basta a liquidare rapidamente e senza cerimonie il paio, prima che abbiano l'occasione di attaccare.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You gently set the animal you captured on the ground in front of you and back away from it slowly, shuffling to the side as the two larger creatures approach it and stroke it gently with their feelers. The smaller one wriggles a little before unfurling its gossamer wings and flitting away into the foliage. The two larger ones eventually follow, though not before one turns around to look at you and Sieasej and vocalizes.|532|0
units.english: You gently set the animal you captured on the ground in front of you and back away from it slowly, shuffling to the side as the two larger creatures approach it and stroke it gently with their feelers. The smaller one wriggles a little before unfurling its gossamer wings and flitting away into the foliage. The two larger ones eventually follow, though not before one turns around to look at you and Sieasej and vocalizes.
units.italian: Posi delicatamente a terra l'animale che hai catturato, davanti a te, e indietreggi lentamente, spostandoti di lato mentre le due creature più grandi gli si avvicinano e lo accarezzano piano con le antenne. Il piccolo si dimena un poco, poi distende le ali di garza e svolazza via nel fogliame. Alla fine le due creature più grandi lo seguono, non prima che una si volti a guardare te e Sieasej e vocalizzi.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|534|0
units.english: release friends
units.italian: release friends

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You gently coax the animal off your arm and onto the ground in front of you, backing away from it slowly and shuffling to the side. It runs towards the larger two creatures, touching the tips of its feelers against theirs and trilling softly as before. After some time, it wriggles a little before unfurling its gossamer wings and flitting away into the foliage. The two larger ones eventually follow, though not before one turns around to look at you and Sieasej and vocalizes, a longer, lower trill almost like a cat's purr.|538|0
units.english: You gently coax the animal off your arm and onto the ground in front of you, backing away from it slowly and shuffling to the side. It runs towards the larger two creatures, touching the tips of its feelers against theirs and trilling softly as before. After some time, it wriggles a little before unfurling its gossamer wings and flitting away into the foliage. The two larger ones eventually follow, though not before one turns around to look at you and Sieasej and vocalizes, a longer, lower trill almost like a cat's purr.
units.italian: Inviti piano l'animale a scendere dal tuo braccio e a posarsi a terra davanti a te, indietreggiando lentamente e spostandoti di lato. Quello corre verso le due creature più grandi, toccando le punte delle loro antenne con le proprie e trillando piano come prima. Dopo un po' si dimena e distende le ali di garza, svolazzando via nel fogliame. Alla fine le due più grandi lo seguono, non prima che una si volti a guardare te e Sieasej e vocalizzi, un trillo più lungo e più basso, quasi come le fusa di un gatto.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	With the larger animals dispatched, you and Sieasej dash into your ship with your quarry safe in tow. The waves of color running over Sieasej's body slowly fade. "Well done, captain," they eventually say. "I'm sure Sioeora will be pleased with thee."|541|0
units.english: With the larger animals dispatched, you and Sieasej dash into your ship with your quarry safe in tow. The waves of color running over Sieasej's body slowly fade. "Well done, captain," they eventually say. "I'm sure Sioeora will be pleased with thee."
units.italian: Liquidate le creature più grandi, tu e Sieasej vi precipitate nella nave con la preda al sicuro. Le onde di colore che scorrono sul corpo di Sieasej si attenuano lentamente. "Ben fatto, capitano," dicono alla fine. "Sono certo che Sioeora sarà compiaciuta di te."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	While Sieasej returns to their cabin, you store the captured Kijra-riitaa in a spare animal-transport cargo container in the <ship>'s hold. It seems to dislike being caged, growling gently and pacing the container, kicking up bits of the straw inside.|542|0
units.english: While Sieasej returns to their cabin, you store the captured Kijra-riitaa in a spare animal-transport cargo container in the <ship>'s hold. It seems to dislike being caged, growling gently and pacing the container, kicking up bits of the straw inside.
units.italian: Mentre Sieasej torna nella propria cabina, riponga il Kijra-riitaa catturato in un contenitore cargo per il trasporto di animali nella stiva della <ship>. Sembra non gradire la gabbia: ringhia piano e va avanti e indietro nel contenitore, sollevando pezzetti di paglia.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Leave it be.)|544|0
units.english: (Leave it be.)
units.italian: (Lascialo stare.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Put some more bedding in the container.)|546|0
units.english: (Put some more bedding in the container.)
units.italian: (Metti un po' più di giaciglio nel contenitore.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Release it.)|547|0
units.english: (Release it.)
units.italian: (Liberalo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You rummage around in the other cargo containers until you find a bit of spare fabric scraps and leaf litter, a couple of handfuls of which you add to the animal's cage. With that sorted out, you make your preparations for takeoff.|551|0
units.english: You rummage around in the other cargo containers until you find a bit of spare fabric scraps and leaf litter, a couple of handfuls of which you add to the animal's cage. With that sorted out, you make your preparations for takeoff.
units.italian: Frughi negli altri contenitori cargo finché non trovi qualche ritaglio di tessuto di scorta e foglie secche, di cui aggiungi un paio di manciate alla gabbia dell'animale. Sistemato questo, fai i preparativi per il decollo.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|553|0
units.english: take off
units.italian: take off

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	With the animal stowed away, you make your preparations for takeoff.|556|0
units.english: With the animal stowed away, you make your preparations for takeoff.
units.italian: Con l'animale sistemato, fai i preparativi per il decollo.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|558|0
units.english: better late than never
units.italian: better late than never

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	You open the container's door and coax the Kijra-riitaa out of your ship. It takes flight shortly after stepping outside, soon disappearing into a speck against the vast blue sky. With nothing left to do here, you make your preparations for takeoff so that you can at least return Sieasej to their people.|561|0
units.english: You open the container's door and coax the Kijra-riitaa out of your ship. It takes flight shortly after stepping outside, soon disappearing into a speck against the vast blue sky. With nothing left to do here, you make your preparations for takeoff so that you can at least return Sieasej to their people.
units.italian: Apri la porta del contenitore e inviti il Kijra-riitaa a uscire dalla nave. Spicca il volo poco dopo essere uscito, sparendo presto in un puntino contro il vasto cielo azzurro. Non resta altro da fare qui, quindi fai i preparativi per il decollo, così da poter almeno riportare Sieasej dai suoi.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	The waves of color running over Sieasej's body slowly fade once the animals are gone. "I confess I hadn't picked thee for such a tender soul," they eventually say.|564|0
units.english: The waves of color running over Sieasej's body slowly fade once the animals are gone. "I confess I hadn't picked thee for such a tender soul," they eventually say.
units.italian: Le onde di colore sul corpo di Sieasej si attenuano lentamente quando gli animali se ne sono andati. "Confesso che non ti avevo preso per un'anima così tenera," dicono alla fine.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"I only did what I thought would get us back alive."|566|0
units.english: "I only did what I thought would get us back alive."
units.italian: "Ho fatto solo ciò che pensavo ci avrebbe riportati a casa vivi."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"It wasn't right to hurt them."|568|0
units.english: "It wasn't right to hurt them."
units.italian: "Non era giusto far loro del male."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Ah," they say. "We are fortunate, then, they thought the same of us."|569|0
units.english: "Ah," they say. "We are fortunate, then, they thought the same of us."
units.italian: "Ah," dicono. "Siamo stati fortunati, allora, che pensassero lo stesso di noi."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|571|0
units.english: back alive
units.italian: back alive

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Ah," they say. "Well I, for one, shall thank thee for thy prudence." After a delay, they add, "Even if my noble house shall not."|572|0
units.english: "Ah," they say. "Well I, for one, shall thank thee for thy prudence." After a delay, they add, "Even if my noble house shall not."
units.italian: "Ah," dicono. "Beh, io per parte mia ti ringrazierò per la prudenza." Dopo una pausa, aggiungono: "Anche se la mia nobile casata non lo farà."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|label|573|0
units.english: released 2
units.italian: released 2

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	Sieasej briefly waves their device in the air unsuccessfully. "Nonetheless," they say, "thine act of mercy here entails us failure. Under threat, the adults shall surely shroud their issues, and so it is now here. It seems we must return with empty arms." They briefly undulate in a manner similar to a laugh. "I do not think I'd take another chase like that again regardless."|574|0
units.english: Sieasej briefly waves their device in the air unsuccessfully. "Nonetheless," they say, "thine act of mercy here entails us failure. Under threat, the adults shall surely shroud their issues, and so it is now here. It seems we must return with empty arms." They briefly undulate in a manner similar to a laugh. "I do not think I'd take another chase like that again regardless."
units.italian: Sieasej agita brevemente il dispositivo nell'aria, senza successo. "Ciò nonostante," dicono, "il tuo atto di clemenza qui ci costa un fallimento. Sotto minaccia, gli adulti nasconderanno di certo i loro piccoli, e così è accaduto qui. Pare che dobbiamo tornare a mani vuote." Ondeggiano brevemente in un modo che somiglia a una risata. "In ogni caso, credo che non affronterei un'altra caccia come questa."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	The two of you return to the <ship> and make preparations for takeoff so that you can, at the very least, return Sieasej to their people.|575|0
units.english: The two of you return to the <ship> and make preparations for takeoff so that you can, at the very least, return Sieasej to their people.
units.italian: Tornate entrambi alla <ship> e fate i preparativi per il decollo, così da poter almeno riportare Sieasej dai suoi.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|dialog|579|0
units.english: You failed to return Sieasej to their people in time. If you wish to continue the Successors' storyline, revert to a prior save.
units.italian: Non sei riuscito a riportare Sieasej dai suoi in tempo. Se vuoi proseguire la linea narrativa dei Successori, torna a un salvataggio precedente.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|log|593|0
units.english: Released the animal House Sioeora requested I bring to them. Returned their citizen, but was barred from further dealings with the House.
units.italian: Hai liberato l'animale che Casa Sioeora ti aveva chiesto di portarle. Hai restituito il loro cittadino, ma ti è stato vietato ogni ulteriore rapporto con la Casa.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|As before, you are directed to House Sioeora's private spaceport in the northern hemisphere, where a landing pad has already been cleared for your arrival. You and Sieasej are given fewer escorts than before, and you can't help but wonder if the absence of your quarry is particularly conspicuous to them. Soon enough, you once again arrive in the scions' chamber, where Riijaaora and the others stand waiting for you.|594|0
units.english: As before, you are directed to House Sioeora's private spaceport in the northern hemisphere, where a landing pad has already been cleared for your arrival. You and Sieasej are given fewer escorts than before, and you can't help but wonder if the absence of your quarry is particularly conspicuous to them. Soon enough, you once again arrive in the scions' chamber, where Riijaaora and the others stand waiting for you.
units.italian: Come prima, vieni indirizzato allo spazioporto privato di Casa Sioeora nell'emisfero settentrionale, dove una piazzola è già stata liberata per il tuo arrivo. A te e a Sieasej vengono assegnate meno scorte di prima, e non puoi fare a meno di chiederti se l'assenza della tua preda sia particolarmente evidente ai loro occhi. Ben presto arrivi di nuovo nella camera degli eredi, dove Riijaaora e gli altri aspettano in piedi.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Hail, captain <last>!" Riijaaora says, this time speaking with their own voice. The sounds feel warped and uneven, as if they are being rearranged midair. "Tell us, hast thou brought that item of our desiring?"|595|0
units.english: "Hail, captain <last>!" Riijaaora says, this time speaking with their own voice. The sounds feel warped and uneven, as if they are being rearranged midair. "Tell us, hast thou brought that item of our desiring?"
units.italian: "Salve, capitano <last>!" dice Riijaaora, questa volta parlando con la propria voce. I suoni sembrano distorti e irregolari, come se venissero riordinati a mezz'aria. "Dicci, hai portato quella cosa che desideriamo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"No, I have not."|597|0
units.english: "No, I have not."
units.italian: "No, non l'ho portata."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"I was almost killed! I'm done doing your dirty work."|598|0
units.english: "I was almost killed! I'm done doing your dirty work."
units.italian: "Sono quasi morto! Ho finito di fare il vostro sporco lavoro."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	A flash of black, ruffled skin passes over Riijaaora's body. Several of the other scions perform similar displays. "'Tis a shame, captain," they say. "If thou can'st offer no utility to this House, then we see little point in retaining thee as an ally, much less rewarding thee for thy absent service. Trouble us no more, and begone." They turn around to face away from you, and the guards slowly peel away from the walls to escort you out. Sieasej remains watching until the door closes shut behind you.|599|0
units.english: A flash of black, ruffled skin passes over Riijaaora's body. Several of the other scions perform similar displays. "'Tis a shame, captain," they say. "If thou can'st offer no utility to this House, then we see little point in retaining thee as an ally, much less rewarding thee for thy absent service. Trouble us no more, and begone." They turn around to face away from you, and the guards slowly peel away from the walls to escort you out. Sieasej remains watching until the door closes shut behind you.
units.italian: Un lampo di pelle nera e arruffata passa sul corpo di Riijaaora. Diversi altri eredi fanno esibizioni simili. "È un peccato, capitano," dicono. "Se non puoi offrire alcuna utilità a questa Casa, allora vediamo poco motivo di tenerti come alleato, e ancor meno di ricompensarti per un servizio che non c'è stato. Non importunarci oltre, e vattene." Si voltano per darti le spalle, e le guardie si staccano lentamente dalle pareti per scortarti fuori. Sieasej resta a guardare finché la porta non si chiude dietro di te.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	As you return to the landing pad, you notice that while your ship has been refueled, the pad itself is slowly being flooded in a none-too-subtle gesture that encourages you to leave.|600|0
units.english: As you return to the landing pad, you notice that while your ship has been refueled, the pad itself is slowly being flooded in a none-too-subtle gesture that encourages you to leave.
units.italian: Mentre torni alla piazzola, noti che la tua nave è stata rifornita, ma la piazzola stessa viene lentamente allagata, in un gesto tutt'altro che sottile che ti invita ad andartene.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|log|616|0
units.english: Captured and returned the animal House Sioeora requested that I bring to them. Was rewarded with a translation device and historical data that allows me to land on most Successor worlds. Was told that assisting in jobs and missions for the Successors would eventually allow me to purchase some of their technology.
units.italian: Hai catturato e riportato l'animale che Casa Sioeora ti aveva chiesto di portarle. Sei stato ricompensato con un dispositivo di traduzione e con dati storici che ti permettono di atterrare sulla maggior parte dei mondi dei Successori. Ti è stato detto che aiutare i Successori in lavori e missioni ti avrebbe alla fine permesso di acquistare parte della loro tecnologia.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|As before, you are directed to House Sioeora's private spaceport in the northern hemisphere, where a landing pad has already been cleared for your arrival. Before leaving, you retrieve the caged Kijra-riitaa from the <ship>'s cargo bay. The animal looks a little pitiful with its wings folded up and body curled into a ball, but appears otherwise undamaged. You and Sieasej are given fewer escorts than before; what escorts you do have direct you deeper into the complex. Soon enough, you once again arrive in the scions' chamber, where Riijaaora and the others stand waiting for you.|617|0
units.english: As before, you are directed to House Sioeora's private spaceport in the northern hemisphere, where a landing pad has already been cleared for your arrival. Before leaving, you retrieve the caged Kijra-riitaa from the <ship>'s cargo bay. The animal looks a little pitiful with its wings folded up and body curled into a ball, but appears otherwise undamaged. You and Sieasej are given fewer escorts than before; what escorts you do have direct you deeper into the complex. Soon enough, you once again arrive in the scions' chamber, where Riijaaora and the others stand waiting for you.
units.italian: Come prima, vieni indirizzato allo spazioporto privato di Casa Sioeora nell'emisfero settentrionale, dove una piazzola è già stata liberata per il tuo arrivo. Prima di uscire, recuperi il Kijra-riitaa in gabbia dalla stiva della <ship>. L'animale ha un'aria un po' compassionevole, con le ali ripiegate e il corpo rannicchiato in una palla, ma per il resto sembra intatto. A te e a Sieasej vengono assegnate meno scorte di prima; quelle che avete vi guidano più a fondo nel complesso. Ben presto arrivi di nuovo nella camera degli eredi, dove Riijaaora e gli altri aspettano in piedi.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Hail, captain <last>!" Riijaaora says, this time speaking with their own voice. The sounds feel warped and uneven, as if they are being rearranged midair. "We see that thou hast returned from thy hunt successful!"|618|0
units.english: "Hail, captain <last>!" Riijaaora says, this time speaking with their own voice. The sounds feel warped and uneven, as if they are being rearranged midair. "We see that thou hast returned from thy hunt successful!"
units.italian: "Salve, capitano <last>!" dice Riijaaora, questa volta parlando con la propria voce. I suoni sembrano distorti e irregolari, come se venissero riordinati a mezz'aria. "Vediamo che sei tornato dalla caccia con successo!"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Yes, I have."|620|0
units.english: "Yes, I have."
units.italian: "Sì, è così."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Of course."|621|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	Riijaaora wriggles their body in what might be an expression of joy before they and the other scions splay their arms before you. "Thou hast done this House great service, captain," they say. "We would be proud to call thee 'ally,' and reward thee for thine usefulness." One of the military officers standing beside the scions moves towards you and gently takes the caged animal from your hands. It chirps quietly as you hand it over.|622|0
units.english: Riijaaora wriggles their body in what might be an expression of joy before they and the other scions splay their arms before you. "Thou hast done this House great service, captain," they say. "We would be proud to call thee 'ally,' and reward thee for thine usefulness." One of the military officers standing beside the scions moves towards you and gently takes the caged animal from your hands. It chirps quietly as you hand it over.
units.italian: Riijaaora si dimena in quello che potrebbe essere un'espressione di gioia, poi, insieme agli altri eredi, apre i bracci davanti a te. "Hai reso un grande servizio a questa Casa, capitano," dicono. "Saremmo orgogliosi di chiamarti 'alleato' e di ricompensarti per la tua utilità." Uno degli ufficiali militari in piedi accanto agli eredi si avvicina e ti prende gentilmente dalle mani l'animale in gabbia. Quello cinguetta piano mentre lo consegni.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	Riijaaora gestures to a small wooden pin affixed to the outer layer of their clothing. "We keep a number of these devices, full of sound and language, but very few for thine own tongue. This one... 'tis an art piece, issued many years past for a performance of thine own Shakespeare's Tempest so that our noble Predecessors could experience the work in its truest form. It is now thy promised gift."|623|0
units.english: Riijaaora gestures to a small wooden pin affixed to the outer layer of their clothing. "We keep a number of these devices, full of sound and language, but very few for thine own tongue. This one... 'tis an art piece, issued many years past for a performance of thine own Shakespeare's Tempest so that our noble Predecessors could experience the work in its truest form. It is now thy promised gift."
units.italian: Riijaaora indica una piccola spilla di legno fissata allo strato esterno del proprio abito. "Conserviamo diversi di questi dispositivi, pieni di suono e di lingua, ma pochissimi per la tua lingua. Questo... è un pezzo d'arte, emesso molti anni fa per una rappresentazione della Tempesta del tuo Shakespeare, perché i nostri nobili Predecessori potessero vivere l'opera nella sua forma più vera. Ora è il dono che ti era promesso."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	Riijaaora plucks the device from their outfit and offers it to you.|624|0
units.english: Riijaaora plucks the device from their outfit and offers it to you.
units.italian: Riijaaora stacca il dispositivo dall'abito e te lo offre.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	(Take it.)|626|0
units.english: (Take it.)
units.italian: (Prendilo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	The device is made of carved wood, or at least something that appears like it, depicting in well-varnished grain a sailing ship washed against rocks. As you pin it on your jacket, the ship begins to gently rock in place and you feel a soft tingling in your ear canals. Riijaaora turns away from you to speak to Sieasej. "And think not, fair citizen, that thine own contributions shall go without recognition. Thou shalt be rewarded, too, for thy part in this." Riijaaora gestures for another officer to escort them away, though not before Sieasej offers you a short splay of their arms as a goodbye.|627|0
units.english: The device is made of carved wood, or at least something that appears like it, depicting in well-varnished grain a sailing ship washed against rocks. As you pin it on your jacket, the ship begins to gently rock in place and you feel a soft tingling in your ear canals. Riijaaora turns away from you to speak to Sieasej. "And think not, fair citizen, that thine own contributions shall go without recognition. Thou shalt be rewarded, too, for thy part in this." Riijaaora gestures for another officer to escort them away, though not before Sieasej offers you a short splay of their arms as a goodbye.
units.italian: Il dispositivo è di legno intagliato, o almeno di qualcosa che vi assomiglia, e raffigura nella venatura ben verniciata una nave a vela spinta contro gli scogli. Mentre lo appunti sulla giacca, la nave comincia a dondolare piano sul posto e senti un leggero formicolio nei condotti uditivi. Riijaaora si volta verso Sieasej per parlare con loro. "E non pensare, onesto cittadino, che il tuo contributo resti senza riconoscimento. Anche tu sarai ricompensato per la tua parte in questo." Riijaaora fa cenno a un altro ufficiale di scortarli via, non prima che Sieasej ti offra un breve aprirsi delle braccia in segno di addio.

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	An officer approaches you to offer you a data-sphere. "Within this," Riijaaora says, "lies knowledge of the history of most worlds within our space. Combined with thy newfound skill of tongues, thou should'st find our worlds and cities more revealing to thy gaze and more fruitful for thine efforts. Thou shall'st be permitted to looks upon our creations and our vessels. Should'st the prospect interest thee, we're sure that the other Houses in their council would agree to extend thee purchase rights, provided thou displays to them thy beneficence and utility. There're many minor tasks which need completion on our worlds; no doubt thy prompt assistance would help in such ingratiation to the others." Riijaaora wiggles. "'Tis all, unless thou hast more questions thou needeth us t'resolve?"|628|0
units.english: An officer approaches you to offer you a data-sphere. "Within this," Riijaaora says, "lies knowledge of the history of most worlds within our space. Combined with thy newfound skill of tongues, thou should'st find our worlds and cities more revealing to thy gaze and more fruitful for thine efforts. Thou shall'st be permitted to looks upon our creations and our vessels. Should'st the prospect interest thee, we're sure that the other Houses in their council would agree to extend thee purchase rights, provided thou displays to them thy beneficence and utility. There're many minor tasks which need completion on our worlds; no doubt thy prompt assistance would help in such ingratiation to the others." Riijaaora wiggles. "'Tis all, unless thou hast more questions thou needeth us t'resolve?"
units.italian: Un ufficiale ti si avvicina per offrirti una sfera di dati. "Dentro questa," dice Riijaaora, "sta la conoscenza della storia della maggior parte dei mondi del nostro spazio. Unita alla tua nuova capacità con le lingue, troverai i nostri mondi e le nostre città più rivelatori al tuo sguardo e più fruttuosi per i tuoi sforzi. Ti sarà permesso guardare le nostre creazioni e i nostri vascelli. Se la prospettiva ti interessa, siamo certi che le altre Casate nel loro consiglio acconsentiranno a estenderti i diritti d'acquisto, purché tu mostri loro la tua benevolenza e la tua utilità. Ci sono molti compiti minori da completare sui nostri mondi; senza dubbio il tuo pronto aiuto gioverà a tale ingraziamento presso gli altri." Riijaaora ondeggia. "È tutto, a meno che tu non abbia altre domande che dobbiamo risolvere?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"I have no questions."|631|0
units.english: "I have no questions."
units.italian: "Non ho domande."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"I have no more questions."|636|0
units.english: "I have no more questions."
units.italian: "Non ho altre domande."

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"Will being your ally bring me into conflict with the other Houses?"|642|0
units.english: "Will being your ally bring me into conflict with the other Houses?"
units.italian: "Essere vostro alleato mi porterà in conflitto con le altre Casate?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	"What are you going to do to the animal?"|646|0
units.english: "What are you going to do to the animal?"
units.italian: "Che cosa farete all'animale?"

units.id: mission:Successors: First Contact 3|	Riijaaora's skin blotches with colors. "Surely not, we think. For none would make so bold a slight as t'endanger the vassal of another. Thou may'st travel 'tween our stars 'thout fear."|653|0
units.english: Riijaaora's skin blotches with colors. "Surely not, we think. For none would make so bold a slight as t'endanger the vassal of another. Thou may'st travel 'tween our stars 'thout fear."
units.italian: La pelle di Riijaaora si macchia di colori. "Di certo no, crediamo. Nessuno oserebbe un affronto tanto ardito da mettere in pericolo il vassallo di un'altra. Puoi viaggiare tra le nostre stelle senza timore."

units.english: "'Tis none of thy concern, fair captain. Though, if thou fear'st cruelty on our part, know well thy gift shall be by us well-kept and well-preserved. Fear not for it, and quell thy doubtful heart."
units.italian: "Non è cosa che ti riguardi, onesto capitano. Tuttavia, se temi crudeltà da parte nostra, sappi che il tuo dono sarà da noi ben custodito e ben conservato. Non temere per lui, e placa il tuo cuore dubbioso."

units.english: "Good. We bid thee good farewells, then, and good tidings in thy travels." Riijaaora and the other scions turn around to face their backs towards you. The officers who escorted you in escort you back out to your ship through the various sculptural passages of Sioeora's complex.
units.italian: "Bene. Ti diamo dunque un buon commiato, e buoni presagi nei tuoi viaggi." Riijaaora e gli altri eredi si voltano per darti le spalle. Gli ufficiali che ti hanno scortato dentro ti riaccompagnano fuori verso la nave, attraverso i vari passaggi scultorei del complesso di Sioeora.
